For G6, “before the run directory” means before that path is authorized as a run/output namespace. After deriving the future `RUN_DIR` but before its signed header, the creator may create only the unique journal temporary, the digest-named signed 89-row registry selected by placement class `RUN_BOOTSTRAP_ARTIFACT_SIGNER_REGISTRY_V1`, and the seven fixed archive rows above—exactly eight immutable input identities and no ninth input/alias. The absent-header invocation provides exactly `--storage-manifest`, `--deployment-manifest`, `--deployment-manifest-signature`, `--deployment-trust-bundle`, `--storage-trust-root`, `--storage-revocation`, and `--storage-checkpoint`, each once with a canonical absolute existing file; the final six parse into `AuthorityStorageTrustBootstrapInputPathsV1`. Creation order is fixed: product-pinned bootstrap-verify the committed 89-row registry, authenticate the broker session and exact-match its registry digest; independently verify the Stage-14 deployment manifest/CMS/trust bundle and signed storage manifest under the embedded product pin and customer roster; then create-new copy, fsync and typed-reload the registry plus all seven archive rows; only then construct and sign the journal header. The storage manifest's own `trust_root_ref|trust_root_digest|root_generation|revocation_ref|checkpoint_ref`, copied trust/root/revocation bytes, TPM-sealed state and independently protected checkpoint must agree; it never self-authorizes its signer or root. `AuthorityStorageTrustBootstrapV1` refs resolve only to the six non-manifest rows, `storage_manifest_ref` resolves only to the fixed manifest row, and the header separately binds the registry digest/ref. A pre-header crash repeats the same grammar and adopts only byte-identical copies under the same eight identities. Once a valid header exists, every continuation/re-entry rejects all seven bootstrap flags and resolves only the authenticated header/archive/registry refs while re-probing the live bound volume. Missing/duplicate/extra/relative/wrong-file input, a ninth input, registry/broker drift, roster/root/bundle/revocation/checkpoint substitution or rollback, revoked signer, ambient Windows-root/network fallback, conflicting prior bytes or one-ref mutation fails before header creation. Byte, unknown-field, trust-rotation, wrong-file and crash-before/after-each-copy goldens keep this bootstrap deterministic, and the offline closure retains all eight locators.

`JournalCheckpointStoreV1` is the sole location authority for every `GateRunJournalCheckpointV1`. From the persisted header and checkpoint `last_sequence` it derives the canonical path/URI `runs/<lowercase-hyphenated-gate_run_id>/checkpoints/<20-digit-zero-padded-last_sequence>.v1.json` below the explicit bundle root, with exact media `application/vnd.ep.f57-gate-run-journal-checkpoint-v1+json`. It create-new writes, fsyncs and typed-reloads one checkpoint for a sequence; an existing exact checkpoint is adopted, while another sequence spelling, overwrite, caller path, conflicting bytes or checkpoint whose prefix does not end at that exact sequence fails closed. Checkpoint refs in candidates, L2/L3, receipts and certificate resolve only through this store.

`TestResultStoreV1` is the only durable location authority for all 276 executable IDs. From the already persisted journal header it derives, never accepts from argv, the canonical URI `evidence-relative://bundle/runs/<lowercase-hyphenated-gate_run_id>/test-results/<ascii-lowercase-TestID>.v1.json`; the filesystem path is the identical segment suffix below the validated bundle root. UUID and TestID grammars make this mapping injective, and percent-encoding, alternate case, alias, symlink/reparse escape or caller-selected filename is rejected. The closed descriptor mapping is: 185 Requirement IDs → `RequirementEvidenceBinding` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-requirement-evidence-binding-v1+json` / `docs/evidence/f57-requirement-evidence-binding.v1.schema.json`; 78 probe IDs → `SliceProbeEvidenceBinding` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-slice-probe-evidence-binding-v1+json` / its same-named schema; three client-conformance auxiliary IDs → `ClientConformanceResult` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-client-conformance-result-v1+json` / its schema; four client-validation auxiliary IDs → `ClientPlatformGateEvidence` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-client-platform-gate-evidence-v1+json` / its schema; six release-carrier auxiliary IDs → `ReleaseCarrierResult` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-release-carrier-result-v1+json` / the consolidated release schema. The registry exact-joins all 276 IDs once, with no default/generic JSON type.

After a durable `TEST_STARTED`, the producer receives the record's one CSPRNG-generated unpredictable `execution_attempt_id`, repeats it inside its typed result (or, for client platform evidence, inside the closed binding), create-new writes that result at the derived path, flushes file and parent directory, typed-reloads the exact bytes, and only then appends `TEST_COMPLETED` with the same ID and ref. Existing bytes are never overwritten. On recovery from `TEST_STARTED`, the registered reconciler resolves only this formula: absent output becomes terminal `TEST_UNKNOWN` carrying the same ID; an existing exact typed result whose TestID, candidate run, execution-attempt ID, signer, media, size, digest and original attempt evidence all verify is adopted byte-for-byte through `TEST_UNKNOWN -> TEST_RECONCILED`; conflicting/partial/wrong-type bytes quarantine the run and fail. A terminal record with a changed ID, missing or different result bytes is corruption. Golden crash cuts cover before output, after durable output before terminal record, after terminal record before response and conflicting pre-existing bytes for each of the five result envelope kinds. Directory scanning, hash search, result re-signing and original-action rerun are forbidden.

For each `(CandidateRunIdentityV1, TestID)`, the only legal state transitions are `ABSENT -> TEST_STARTED -> TEST_COMPLETED` during an uninterrupted execution, or `ABSENT -> TEST_STARTED -> TEST_UNKNOWN -> TEST_RECONCILED` after recovery of that same physical attempt. The unpredictable `execution_attempt_id` is generated once immediately before the STARTED append, is immutable across every later state/result/raw context, and is never accepted from argv or regenerated on resume. Before reading state, every mutating command acquires a journal-wide OS exclusive lease on the journal plus the exact sidecar `<run-journal>.lock`; on Windows both handles deny write/delete sharing and the sidecar records the run ID plus unpredictable owner token. State check, `TEST_STARTED` append and file/parent-directory durability occur inside that lease. For every non-`POWER_SHUTDOWN` recipe the lease remains held through physical invocation and terminal append/checkpoint. `POWER_SHUTDOWN` is the one necessary cross-reboot exception: the lease remains held through each atomic state/journal append and through the pre-shutdown dispatch handshake, is released only by process/OS termination, and is reacquired by the post-boot privileged re-entry; its signed prefix, fixed SCM service and exact attempt-tagged Windows event provide the cross-boot mutual exclusion. A concurrent command that cannot acquire the applicable lease returns `F57_JOURNAL_BUSY`/exit 1 before any side effect. Process death releases the OS lease; a successor may acquire it but sees the durable nonterminal state and may invoke only the registered reconciler/continuation transition, never the original action. A stale sidecar file alone grants no ownership and is never deleted by guessing.

`TEST_STARTED` is appended and file/parent-directory durability is confirmed before invocation; every later record is likewise appended and flushed before its referenced result/checkpoint is exposed. `TEST_COMPLETED` and `TEST_RECONCILED` are terminal. A stranded `TEST_STARTED` is first closed as `TEST_UNKNOWN`; its registered reconciler may then prove and bind the one original result as `TEST_RECONCILED`, otherwise `TEST_UNKNOWN` remains candidate-failing. No state permits a second start, second result, rerun, result replacement, or favorable-result selection; another physical attempt requires a new run ID. CandidateBound Fresh-PG is the only `EvidenceOperationStarted|Completed|Unknown|Reconciled` operation kind and receives one immutable `execution_attempt_id` before its disposable-database side effect. Client validation, artifact-set, L2/L3, receipts and certificate do not pretend that deterministic signing is an irreversible physical operation: only after every constituent TestID/operation is terminal do they append `EvidenceEnvelopeFinalizationStarted` with one `finalization_attempt_id` and frozen checkpoint, and candidate manifests use the corresponding `CandidateManifestFinalizationStarted`. Recovery may perform the first signing/write from those frozen inputs or adopt exact existing bytes; it never reruns a constituent action, re-signs already complete bytes or changes frozen time values. Pre-manifest client/Fresh-PG results retain their original run identity without circular hashing while later envelopes additionally exact-match the manifest ref.

The run namespace is not caller-chosen output naming. The run journal file name is exactly `gate-run.jcs.jsonl`; `RUN_DIR` is its canonical parent and must be a descendant of the explicit bundle root. One immutable journal header owns that directory forever and records both unpredictable run identity and one `maximal_profile: DeliveryProfileV1`; a different profile/identity or a second physical attempt must use another run directory. Reusing `DeliveryProfileV1` is deliberate: there is no second isomorphic run-target enum. `EvidenceEnvelopeKindV1` and `CandidateManifestKindV1` serialize their displayed Rust variants in exact `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`; lower/camel case or a `TargetGateV1` string in either field is rejected. Before header creation the directory may contain only explicitly verified static inputs and the journal's create-new temporary file, never another run-bound output. `EvidenceEnvelopeStoreV1` and `CandidateManifestStoreV1` derive every location from `(bundle root,RUN_DIR,journal header,maximal profile,kind)` and never from a scan, timestamp, digest search, ambient working directory, or caller filename. The journal-header, envelope-bound-event, and both descriptor-map byte-goldens cover every profile/kind plus unknown/case-drift negatives.

Ranges above mean the exact inclusive ordinal suffix of `DeliveryProfileV1`, not a free-form comparison. “Same” cells expand byte-for-byte to the preceding exact media/path; they are not implementation wildcards. The three L2 kinds intentionally share one filename because the immutable maximal profile admits exactly one of them. The generated descriptor golden exact-joins all 14 fully expanded `EvidenceEnvelopeStoreV1` rows and rejects a generic JSON type, unknown kind, profile outside the allowed set, filename alias, duplicate resolved path within one profile, or schema/media drift. `EvidenceEnvelopeKindV1::OfflineSchemaManifest` is the one explicit special-store finalization kind: it is legal only for `G6_RELEASE` and resolves only through `OfflineSchemaManifestStoreV1`, never through this 14-row descriptor map.

A supplied `--out`, `--candidate-manifest`, `--l2-evidence`, `--l3-evidence`, `--validation`, or `--client-artifacts` referring to a same-run artifact must exact-match its store-derived canonical path. A gate's `--evidence-out` must exact-match the parent of that target's current receipt/certificate path. This preserves the human-readable paths in the child plans while making them non-configurable. External signed inputs are still typed-verified and materialized under `inputs/<exact-envelope-sha256>.json`; they never become same-run aliases.

Constituent TestIDs and physical operations always reach terminal or reconciled state before an aggregate envelope or candidate manifest begins finalization. Client validation, client artifact set, offline schema manifest, runtime-topology certification, L2/L3, G0…G5 receipts and the release certificate are therefore pure deterministic aggregations at this point; CandidateBound Fresh-PG follows its separate operation protocol above. For an aggregate, the producer signs and stores a checkpoint that freezes the complete input prefix, then durably appends `EVIDENCE_ENVELOPE_FINALIZATION_STARTED{artifact_kind,finalization_attempt_id,frozen_input_checkpoint_ref,issued_at_unix_ms,expires_at_unix_ms}` before creating the envelope; these are the exact five field names and no `kind`, `issued_at` or `expires_at` alias is accepted. `OfflineSchemaManifest` uses the same event/adopt protocol but writes only through its special store; its payload repeats the finalization ID. Runtime-topology certification is the one plain deterministic aggregation: after a checkpoint authenticates the terminal P340 result, its producer create-new stores exact JCS bytes in `EvidenceObjectStoreV1`; recovery follows only the checkpoint-fixed declaration/P340/capacity refs and adopts identical bytes without a signing event. Candidate manifests analogously append `CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_FINALIZATION_STARTED` only after their candidate-required precursor exact-set is durable and terminal: G4/G5 consume client/authority/Fresh-PG precursors, while final G6 consumes client validation/artifact set, `WINDOWS_AUTHORITY_BUILD`, `WINDOWS_SERVICE_INSTALL`, the final-installed `OBSERVED_COMMITTED` generation/declaration/ACK closure, the bound offline schema manifest and CandidateBound Fresh-PG—never the four post-freeze carrier rows or the later topology certification. The candidate finalization expiry is the checked minimum of the journal-header expiry and every time-bearing precursor, including validation, artifact set and all four reachable signed-package-wrapper expiries. The finalization record freezes every time-bearing scalar and the only legal store path, so recovery may perform the first and only signing/write from that same frozen input after a crash; it never reruns a constituent action. An existing unbound output is typed-verified and adopted byte-for-byte through RECONCILED; an already bound output must exact-match and returns idempotently; conflicting/partial/wrong-type bytes, a second kind/ref, re-sign of existing complete bytes, overwrite, fallback filename or directory scan quarantines and fails the run. Each kind occurs at most once. Legal order is unique: G4 uses CandidateBound Fresh-PG → candidate → Development L2 → receipts; G5 uses client validation → client artifact set → CandidateBound Fresh-PG → candidate → Integration L2 → receipts; final G6 uses client validation → client artifact set → `WINDOWS_AUTHORITY_BUILD` → `WINDOWS_SERVICE_INSTALL` → final-installed generation/declaration activation to exact `OBSERVED_COMMITTED` → offline schema manifest → CandidateBound Fresh-PG → final candidate freeze/bound → `POSTGRES16_PITR` → `BACKUP_RESTORE_CERTIFICATION` → `P340_RELEASE72_HOUR` → runtime-topology certification → `POWER_SHUTDOWN` → Final L2 with all six carrier refs → L3 → fresh G0…G5 receipts → release certificate → separately authorized production activation. G0–G3 begin with CandidateBound Fresh-PG then ascending receipts. Thus every later payload checkpoint authenticates a strict prefix extension even when no new TestID ran. The release certificate's own checkpoint precedes its bound event, while that final event exists solely for crash recovery/idempotent re-entry. A torn/incomplete or unauthenticated tail is preserved as a quarantine artifact, only the last authenticated checkpoint may resume, and framing/sequence/hash/signature/candidate/state/result/envelope drift fails closed.

The G0 PowerShell trust boundary is mandatory for every engineering and release `.ps1` execution. Its low-cost default uses a self-hosted non-exportable CNG code-signing key and private RFC-3161 TSA; an existing enterprise signer/TSA can connect only through the same pinned policy. Each script's post-signature bytes have one strict descriptor binding repository path, whole-file/content digests, leaf certificate/SPKI/DN/EKU, timestamp identity/time and offline revocation/policy digests. The final invocation-graph closure is exactly 18 scripts: the L2/L3 wrappers, six Task-10 authority scripts, two backup/PITR scripts, the restore drill, and seven P340/POWER scripts. Task 14 compiles all 18 verified descriptors into the sole generated release registry after re-signing every script it changes. A nested child is another registry edge and is never invoked by raw path.

Execution never resolves `powershell.exe` or a script through PATH/current directory. Rust obtains `%SystemRoot%` through `GetWindowsDirectoryW`, opens and Microsoft-verifies the final `%SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe`, opens the clean source root and registered script component-by-component without reparse points, denies write/delete sharing and holds both final handles through child exit. It verifies machine `TrustedPublisher`, offline chain/revocation/RFC-3161 state and effective `AllSigned`; after durable STARTED it rechecks the same file IDs, final paths, descriptor hashes and signatures before `CreateProcessW` with canonical absolute host/script paths. Any edit requires re-signing and registry regeneration. No `Bypass|RemoteSigned`, relative `-File`, alternate host, stale descriptor, TOCTOU replacement, caller script/command or direct one-step execute overload exists. In the table below, “after `powershell.exe`” is only the logical fixed argv template; the executor substitutes the verified canonical host and absolute script path.

Release-bearing PowerShell is never invoked directly as candidate evidence. `cargo xtask f57 carrier run` accepts only the six closed `ReleaseCarrierRecipeIdV1` variants, maps each variant to one compiled repository script path, exact argument set, result schema, TestID, trusted runner, registry-selected SPKI signer token, additional certificate-DN constraint and reconciler, appends/fsyncs `TEST_STARTED` with one unpredictable outer execution-attempt ID, then launches that fixed AllSigned script through the trust boundary and typed-verifies its output before appending the terminal record with the same ID. `BACKUP_RESTORE_CERTIFICATION` owns the exact ordered 1/2/3 clean-restore sequence as one outer execution attempt while the already signed `recipe_specific` plan supplies three distinct subordinate `recovery_execution_attempt_id` values, one per physical restore. It accepts no arbitrary command, script path, TestID, mode, runner, signer, subattempt ID or extra argument. The two pre-freeze recipes exact-bind clean `HEAD` to the existing journal header; the other four require the exact signed release-candidate manifest and its bound event. G0 delivers the generic dispatcher/journal engine with every release recipe `NOT_DELIVERED`; G6 Task 14 activates the six mappings only after their scripts and reconcilers are committed.

The dispatcher registry is exactly the following six rows. `<candidate>` is the explicitly supplied absolute signed candidate path. `<staging>` is never caller supplied: only after durable STARTED it is derived as `<RUN_DIR>\carrier-staging\<ascii-lowercase-TestID>\<lowercase-hyphenated-execution_attempt_id>` and is the sole place from which that row's reconciler may load create-new script output. Every other script input is a plan-bound fixed file under `<staging>\inputs`; no script traverses a journal, object store, result, candidate sibling or directory to discover one. Rust substitutes and shell-escapes these exact paths. Staging bytes are not evidence URIs: the dispatcher typed-loads them, ingests raw envelopes and all nested bytes into `EvidenceObjectStoreV1`, then writes the one `ReleaseCarrierResultV1` through `TestResultStoreV1`; recovery uses STARTED's exact plan/ID/path and never scans outside that single staging directory. Each carrier TestID is registered auxiliary evidence, deliberately outside the 185 Requirement due-set; graph-bound Requirement handlers consume its signed result and produce the due-set `TestResultRefV1` rows. Every raw evidence object is wrapped by signed `ReleaseCarrierResultV1` (`application/vnd.ep.f57-release-carrier-result-v1+json`) whose purpose serializes `EP-F57-RELEASE-CARRIER-RESULT-V1`, binding is exactly `PRE_FREEZE` for the first two rows and `SIGNED_CANDIDATE` for the other four. Its issued time is captured once at deterministic finalization; expiry is exactly the checked minimum of `issued+F57_EVIDENCE_MAX_LIFETIME_MS`, journal-header expiry, staging-plan expiry, staging-completion expiry and every nested raw expiry. Result creation/reconciliation typed-loads both staging refs under their exact media and rejects an expired input, extension, overflow or omitted minimum.

While holding the journal lease and before STARTED, Rust typed-loads every required input, generates the one `execution_attempt_id`, derives the recipe's closed input/output sets, captures `issued_at_unix_ms=trusted_now`, and derives plan expiry as the checked minimum of `issued_at+F57_EVIDENCE_MAX_LIFETIME_MS`, the journal-header expiry and every time-bearing typed input expiry; every such input must be live at issuance. It signs one `CarrierStagingPlanV1` under exact media `application/vnd.ep.f57-carrier-staging-plan-v1+json` and create-new stores that plan in `EvidenceObjectStoreV1`. It then appends and fsyncs `TEST_STARTED` with that same ID and exact singleton `start_context_refs=[staging_plan_ref]`; that occurrence must use the staging-plan media. Only after this durable record may it derive/create `<staging>`, create-new copy the exact plan to `<staging>\plan.v1.json`, and create-new copy each already verified input to its plan-bound path. A crash after the content-addressed plan but before STARTED leaves only an unreachable immutable object; a later invocation never scans or adopts it. A crash after STARTED is recovery of that exact attempt and never creates a new plan or invokes the original script again. Header/input/cap minimum drift, `issued_at>=expires_at`, overflow, missing/extra start-context ref or a media alias fails before script execution.

The recipe input sets are exact: `WINDOWS_AUTHORITY_BUILD|POSTGRES16_PITR|BACKUP_RESTORE_CERTIFICATION` have `{}`; `WINDOWS_SERVICE_INSTALL` has `{WINDOWS_AUTHORITY_ARTIFACT_SET -> inputs/windows-authority-artifact-set.v1.json -> application/vnd.ep.f57-windows-authority-artifact-set-v1+json, WINDOWS_AUTHORITY_MANIFEST -> inputs/windows-authority-manifest.v1.json -> application/vnd.ep.f57-windows-authority-manifest-v1+json, WINDOWS_AUTHORITY_MSI -> inputs/windows-authority.msi -> application/octet-stream}`. Those three service inputs plus the nested graph-exact runtime deployment closure and server-component set are obtained only by typed traversal of the same terminal build result: the staged signed `WindowsAuthorityArtifactSetV1` exact-names the staged manifest, MSI, `runtime_deployment_closure_ref` and `server_component_set_ref`, while `ReleaseWindowsServiceInstallEvidenceV1.authority_artifacts_ref`, `.installed_msi_ref`, `.runtime_deployment_closure_ref`, `.runtime_deployment_readback_set_ref` and `.server_component_set_ref` exact-match that source set and its installed result; the script cannot synthesize or discover any ref. `WINDOWS_SERVICE_INSTALL` materializes every graph-`ACTIVE` row according to its frozen carrier and produces exactly one carrier-specific positive dynamic readback per active participant plus one `DEFERRED_ABSENT` readback per graph-`DEFERRED_DISABLED` participant. It separately constructs every one of the five immutable Authority service rows from that source set: each row's `installed_binary_ref` exact-equals `WindowsAuthorityArtifactSetV1.authority_binary_ref`, and its installed-file attestation proves those same bytes at the pinned executable path. It installs/starts writer, checkpoint-signer and data-volume-unlock-broker services, installs but does not background-start recovery-tool/passphrase-helper, and proves the separately deployed off-host target agent without installing it on the P340. The complete CapabilityGraph participant-ID set is a bijection with the complete deployment-closure participant-ID set and complete installed-readback participant-ID set. Separately, the graph-`ACTIVE` participant-ID set is a bijection with positive-readback participant IDs, `RuntimeTopologyDeclarationV1.participants[].participant_id`, `GenerationManifestV1.required_participants[].participant_id`, and `GenerationParticipantV1.participant_id` ACKs. `RuntimeTopologyDeclarationV1.database_consumers` is the independent exact graph-derived database-consumer projection for active service identities: an active participant may have zero or multiple consumer rows, but every consumer service identity must resolve to the active projection and no deferred identity may own one. `GenerationManifestV1.items` is likewise an independent canonical exact set derived from the active graph plus final installed artifact/configuration facts; each required participant's `required_item_ids` must equal its graph-derived canonical item subset, the participant-to-item relation may be many-to-many, every item must be referenced by at least one required participant, and no ID outside that item set may be referenced. Every `DEFERRED_DISABLED` row has only its negative absence readback and is forbidden from artifact, declaration participant, database-consumer, required-participant, participant-item edge or ACK sets. Missing/extra/duplicate participant, consumer, item or relation edge; orphan item; active-but-absent; deferred-but-present; wrong carrier/host/artifact/config; or stale configuration generation fails before PASS. `P340_RELEASE72_HOUR` has `{P340_CERTIFICATION_POLICY_ATTESTATION -> inputs/p340-certification-policy-attestation.v1.json -> application/vnd.ep.f57-p340-certification-policy-attestation-v1+json, P340_CAPACITY_INPUT_MANIFEST -> inputs/p340-capacity-input-manifest.v1.json -> application/vnd.ep.f57-p340-capacity-input-manifest-v1+json}`; and `POWER_SHUTDOWN` has `{UPS_IDENTITY_READBACK -> inputs/ups-identity-readback.v1.json -> application/vnd.ep.f57-ups-identity-readback-v1+json, UPS_POWER_WRITE_CACHE_POLICY -> inputs/ups-power-write-cache-policy.v1.json -> application/vnd.ep.f57-ups-power-write-cache-policy-v1+json}` obtained only by typed traversal of the terminal P340 result, soak and capacity-input chain. `inputs` sort by enum wire, paths/media are exactly those values, every `artifact_ref` exact-matches the staged bytes, and any other input, duplicate, cross-run/candidate ref or unreachable source fails before STARTED.

The five service-install fields, seven PITR scalar slots (the two offline-media roles count separately), and six recovery-certification field selectors form one closed subordinate-readback registry. docs/evidence/f57-release-evidence.schema.json is its sole schema/source owner; the compiled artifact kind is RELEASE_CARRIER_SUBORDINATE_READBACK_V1. Every leaf is strict plain JCS, not a signed envelope: it has exactly schema_version=1, its fixed purpose, and context byte-equal to the containing ReleasePhysicalEvidenceContextV1, with deny_unknown_fields at every object. PITR and recovery leaves additionally exact-repeat the same `authority_recovery_cut_manifest_ref`, its whole-object digest and `write_barrier_id`; the outer checkpoint exact-loads and repeats that tuple. Recovery leaves also repeat certification ID, certification run and phase. The containing signed raw carrier authenticates the ref and binding; EvidenceObjectStoreV1 verifies size/digest/media, selects the parser only from the containing field plus closed role discriminator, strict-parses before ingest, and exposes no caller-selected parser, path, file search or directory scan. These leaves add no artifact-signer-registry row and have no independent issuance/expiry.

`ReleasePostgres16PitrEvidencePayloadV1` is the unique strict sixteen-field wire. Its mandatory `backup_checkpoint_ref` typed-loads exact media `application/vnd.ep.f57-backup-checkpoint-v1+json` under the dedicated BACKUP recovery trust domain, then exact-matches backup manifest, EPB1 graph, target receipts, key-envelope/recovery-domain digests, release/config generations and database/WAL/attachment cuts. It is a direct typed root ref, not a subordinate parser row. Every `CLEAN_SOURCE_CUT.source_pitr_raw_ref` must resolve this same PITR raw and repeat the same checkpoint ref; missing/raw/generic/wrong-domain/cross-set/stale checkpoint or a different clean-cut checkpoint fails. The offline closure includes the sole backup-checkpoint and recovery-domain-manifest schemas/trust descriptors without adding an F57 signer-registry row.

The generated descriptor table has exactly the eighteen rows above in numeric order and exactly seventeen unique parser definitions because rows 11/12 deliberately share one role-tagged parser. The six recovery selectors are reused, not redefined, for raw ordinals 00/01/02; therefore one complete carrier execution contains exactly 5 + 7 + (3 * 6) = 30 instantiated leaf objects while the schema/offline registry still has exactly 5 + 7 + 6 = 18 field bindings. For each occurrence, the existing concrete-artifact-key constructor includes root type, raw ordinal, JSON pointer and vector role, derives its sole plan entry/path, and the raw field ref must exact-equal the ingested object. The PITR offline vector is canonical role order [ROTATION_A,ROTATION_B], never index-selected by a caller; the recovery raw set is canonical order 00=run 1/INITIAL_RESTORE_VERIFIED, 01=run 2/CANDIDATE_MEASURED, 02=run 3/CERTIFIED. Missing/extra/duplicate selector, leaf alias between raw ordinals, repeated offline role, or an instance count other than 5/7/18 for those three recipe-local families fails before raw outcome evaluation.

The five service parsers expose complete typed projections rather than Boolean claims. SERVICE_SID yields services[{service_role,service_name,virtual_account_name,service_sid,sid_type}] and must equal the exact five-role Authority installed-service set and each nested installed row. SERVICE_DACL yields services[{service_role,service_name,service_sid,scm_dacl_canonical_sddl,scm_dacl_sha256,effective_ace_set_sha256}]; every canonical SDDL digest is recomputed and the role/name/SID/SDDL values exact-equal the installed attestation and the manifest-derived least-privilege template. IPC_DACL yields endpoints[{endpoint_role,endpoint_path,owner_service_sid,canonical_sddl,canonical_sddl_sha256}] for exactly AUTHORITY_RECOVERY_PROOF, CONTROL_BROKER, RAW_EVIDENCE_SIGNER and GATE_RUN_JOURNAL_SIGNER; endpoint, owner and digest exact-match the corresponding installed variant and generated ACL template. Authority/control/raw-facade/journal-facade each require `RUNNING` dynamic readback bound to boot ID, nonzero PID plus boot-scoped process-start key, held image, token SID and one unpredictable role-specific authenticated nonce/session; the continuation instead requires exactly one same-boot dormant self-check followed by `STOPPED`, exit `0`, zero side effects/recovery actions and absent `ActiveRecordPath`. STORAGE_ROUTING yields storage_manifest_ref, storage_root_binding, runtime_ssd_volume_identity, data_hdd_volume_identity, authority_root_rows and runtime_ssd_customer_authority_bytes; it exact-reconstructs the journal-header binding, every authority root resolves by final handle to DATA_HDD, and the SSD byte count is zero. TRUSTED_TIME yields windows_boot_id, w32time_service_running, w32time_synchronized, w32time_source, w32time_offset_milliseconds, w32time_last_successful_sync_age_seconds, clock_rollback_negative_passed and clock_fast_forward_negative_passed; PASS requires a nonempty non-local/free-running source, both service/synchronized true, checked abs(i128(offset)) <= 1000, sync age <= 3600, both negative probes true and a nonempty boot ID; all five leaf contexts already byte-equal the one outer context. The outer WINDOWS_SERVICE_INSTALL outcome is PASS iff all five leaves, the separate graph-exact `WindowsRuntimeDeploymentReadbackSetV1`, every Authority/component runtime readback and every equality above hold.

The seven PITR slots likewise parse evidence. DATABASE_CUT yields the full-cut ref/digest/barrier tuple, server_version, server_version_num, postgres_system_identifier, timeline_id, checkpoint_lsn, backup_start_lsn, backup_stop_lsn, base_backup_manifest_sha256, database_logical_digest, row_count and integrity_check_passed. `server_version` is the exact server-reported UTF-8 version string and `server_version_num` is the exact positive PostgreSQL integer setting; PASS requires checked integer `server_version_num / 10000 = 16` and outer `postgres_version` to byte-equal `server_version`. WAL_CUT yields the same cut tuple/system/timeline, start_lsn, end_lsn, first_segment, last_segment, segment_count, archive_manifest_sha256, missing_segment_count and checksum_error_count. ATTACHMENT_CUT yields the same tuple plus attachment_manifest_sha256, object_count, total_bytes, missing_count and corrupt_count. APPEND_ONLY yields the same tuple plus `storage_safeguard_readback_ref`, backup_target_identity, retention_lock_identity, append_only_enforced, overwrite_attempt_denied, delete_attempt_denied and unexpected_mutation_count. KEY_DOMAIN yields the same tuple plus database_key_id, attachment_key_id, backup_key_id, recovery_key_id, all_domains_distinct, bundle_contains_recovery_material and wrong_domain_decrypt_denied. Each OFFLINE_ROTATION_MEDIA leaf yields the same tuple plus that identical `storage_safeguard_readback_ref`, media_role, media_identity, volume_identity, cut_set_sha256, encrypted, detached_offline, health_passed and bundle_contains_recovery_material. The tuple must exact-load one complete `AuthorityRecoveryCutManifestV1`, whose row set covers every enabled HDD authority class at that barrier; all three safeguard refs typed-load the same current `StorageSafeguardReadbackV1`, whose `backup_topology_ref` exact-equals the cut's `backup_topology_ref` and whose binding is this PITR attempt/checkpoint. PASS additionally requires one system/timeline; checkpoint/start/stop and WAL ranges form a checked gap-free closure; all missing/corrupt/checksum/mutation counts are zero; append-only and denial flags are true; the four key IDs are pairwise distinct, and the two media identities and two volume identities are respectively distinct; no bundle/media leaf contains recovery material; exactly roles A/B are encrypted, healthy and detached; and both cut_set_sha256 values equal SHA256(JCS of the exact database/WAL/attachment/append-only/key-domain ref tuple). The outer POSTGRES16_PITR outcome is PASS iff all seven scalar slots satisfy those relations. Schema/byte goldens independently mutate version string, numeric version, major boundary, full-cut backup set/context/completeness/barrier and outer equality.

Each recovery leaf repeats the common certification binding and the exact full-cut ref/digest/barrier tuple. CLEAN_SOURCE_CUT additionally yields source_pitr_raw_ref, database_cut_ref, wal_cut_ref, attachment_cut_ref, append_only_readback_ref, key_domain_readback_ref, both role-tagged offline_media_readback_refs and cut_set_sha256; all three certification runs must exact-repeat the same terminal PITR source and complete cut and may not select a newer/alternate cut. RESTORED_DATABASE yields postgres_system_identifier, timeline_id, replayed_through_lsn, logical_digest, row_count, integrity_check_passed, missing_row_count and corruption_count; it must replay through at least the source stop/end LSN and exact-match the source logical digest/row count with both error counts zero. RESTORED_ATTACHMENT yields attachment_manifest_sha256, object_count, total_bytes, missing_count, corrupt_count and orphan_count; all source values exact-match and all three counts are zero. AUDIT_OUTBOX_REPLAY yields source_audit_head_sha256, final_audit_head_sha256, expected_audit_record_count, replayed_audit_record_count, expected_outbox_message_count, replayed_outbox_message_count, chain_valid, lost_count, duplicate_count and unexplained_count; both expected/replayed count pairs are equal, chain_valid is true and all three error counts are zero. KEY_CUSTODY yields database_key_id, attachment_key_id, backup_key_id, recovery_key_id, custody_quorum, distinct_custodian_domains, recovery_material_external, wrong_key_denied and authorized_unlock_passed; IDs exact-match the source, quorum is 2, at least two domains exist, separated external material is true and both tests pass. BUSINESS_REOPEN yields authority_service_ready, authenticated_query_probe_count, authenticated_command_probe_count, data_mismatch_count, fact_mismatch_count, audit_mismatch_count and reopen_passed; readiness/reopen are true, both probe counts are nonzero and every mismatch is zero. A recovery raw PASS is derived only when all six leaves PASS and their context/certification/full-cut relations exact-match; aggregate certification PASS additionally requires the unique ordered 1/2/3 phase set, the same source cut across all three, and no ref cherry-pick between phases.

For the same candidate, `DATABASE_CUT.postgres_system_identifier`, `WAL_CUT.postgres_system_identifier` and every one of the three `RESTORED_DATABASE.postgres_system_identifier` values must byte-equal the `Postgres16WindowsInstallReadbackV1.postgres_system_identifier` reached through that candidate's exact terminal Windows-service-install evidence; that outer identifier already byte-equals the independently read engine `cluster_system_identifier|pg_control_system_identifier|sql_system_identifier`. The join follows typed candidate/evidence refs and never accepts a loose identifier, latest install, same-version cluster or caller-supplied ref. A one-field system-identifier substitution in any cut, restore run, install outer value or one of the three engine observations fails before PITR/recovery PASS.

Task 14 implements the sole field-to-parser constructor and the seventeen strict schema definitions in the release owner; scripts receive only the signed staging plan and cannot override this map. Generated goldens freeze the exact eighteen descriptor rows, seventeen parser IDs, two-role vector, three recovery phase rows, thirty instantiated leaves, purpose/media/parser equality and every PASS predicate. One-field, unknown-field, generic-JSON/octet-stream, same-media cross-parser, context/run/outer-attempt/recovery-subattempt/candidate/cut/certification/phase drift, offline role/identity alias, gap/LSN/digest/count/key/custody/reopen mutation, claimed PASS with any failing leaf, unplanned path and any added signer row all fail closed.

`CarrierStagingPlanPayloadV1.recipe_specific` is `NONE` for five recipes and exactly `RECOVERY_CERTIFICATION{certification_id,runs}` for `BACKUP_RESTORE_CERTIFICATION`. Its three fixed rows are `1/INITIAL_RESTORE_VERIFIED`, `2/CANDIDATE_MEASURED`, `3/CERTIFIED`, contain distinct unpredictable `recovery_execution_attempt_id` values generated before carrier STARTED, and byte-bind the later recovery-policy artifact and raw `00|01|02` payloads. These are subordinate physical-run identities; the signed plan, journal STARTED, all three raw contexts and outer result retain one outer carrier `execution_attempt_id`. Missing, extra, reordered, duplicate or caller-selected subattempt, a second certification ID, or `recipe_specific` on any other recipe fails before a restore side effect.

`CarrierStagingPlanPayloadV1.continuation` is exact `NONE` for the first five recipes. Only `POWER_SHUTDOWN` requires `POWER_SHUTDOWN`, with a fresh continuation ID, `continuation_binary_ref` exact-matching the final candidate authority set's `authority_binary_ref`, the installed continuation row's `service.installed_binary_ref`, and the Authenticode-verified installed `ep-core-server.exe`, plus canonical absolute `bundle_root_path`, `run_journal_path`, and derived `staging_root_path`; no SCM field is inferred from a directory. The MSI has already installed all five permanent Authority services—ordinary Authority, dormant continuation, control broker and both keyless signing facades—before candidate freeze; the power attempt never creates, deletes or reconfigures a Windows service. The installed executable is exactly `C:\Program Files\EnterprisePlatform\Authority\ep-core-server.exe`. Continuation service name/display/account are exactly `EPF57PowerShutdownContinuation`, `Enterprise Platform F57 Power Shutdown Continuation`, and `NT SERVICE\EPF57PowerShutdownContinuation`; its numeric `service_sid` is resolved and verified by the common `WindowsSidV1` rule below; start/SID/recovery are permanently `AUTO_START`, `UNRESTRICTED`, and `NO_AUTOMATIC_RESTART`. On any ordinary boot with no `ActiveRecordPath` value, ServiceMain performs a read-only dormant check and exits `STOPPED` without side effects. Dependencies sort exactly as `[CryptSvc,EPAuthorityControl,EPAuthorityServer,EventLog]`, so ordinary Authority recovery and the control broker initialize before continuation ServiceMain can run; required privileges are exactly `[SeChangeNotifyPrivilege]`, deliberately excluding `SeShutdownPrivilege`. The permanent source-order argv is exactly `power-shutdown-continuation --activation-source scm-parameter` with no per-attempt argument, shell or quoting branch. The control broker writes one exact canonical absolute active-plan path as value `ActiveRecordPath` inside `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\EPF57PowerShutdownContinuation\Parameters\F57ActivationV1`; that signed plan carries every run/path/attempt/continuation value, and the value is absent while dormant and after disarm. `phase_state_run_relative_path` is exactly `continuation-state/<ascii-lowercase-carrier-TestID>/<lowercase-hyphenated-execution_attempt_id>/power-shutdown-state.v1.jcs.jsonl` below `RUN_DIR`; `success_persistence_command_relative_path` and the raw staging path are exactly `continuation/power-shutdown-success-persistence-command.v1.json` and `raw/00.v1.json`.

The three bundle/run/staging paths may resolve to the certified DATA_HDD and are never assumed boot-available. Therefore the POWER plan additionally fixes one bounded boot control capsule at exact `C:\ProgramData\EnterprisePlatform\continuation-control\power-shutdown\<lowercase-hyphenated-execution_attempt_id>\` on the certified RUNTIME_SSD. `PowerShutdownControlCapsulePlanV1` is exactly `residency_class=NO_BUSINESS_DATA`; complete `CandidateIdentityV1`; permanent bundle registry ref; runtime-volume identity; literal root; relative paths `plan.v1.json`, `artifact-signer-registry.v1.json`, `gate-run-prefix-through-pre-shutdown-committed.bin`, `continuation-state-prefix-through-pre-shutdown-committed.bin`, `dispatch-commit-intent.v1.json`, `dispatch-api-call-committed.v1.json`, `dispatch-acknowledgement.v1.json`, `postboot-resume-controller.v1.jcs.jsonl`, `failure.v1.json`, `failure-cleanup.v1.json`; and `maximum_total_bytes=33554432`. Registry, intent, API-commit and composite-acknowledgement paths are fixed SSD locators whose exact bytes are also retained by their ordinary refs; they are not new URI schemes. Identity digest, canonical handle/volume/non-reparse path and cap checks remain mandatory. The capsule contains only registry, plan, immutable intent/API-commit/composite-acknowledgement controls, authenticated row-2 prefixes, postboot controller and mutually exclusive failure/cleanup—not business data. Each inline raw component is at most `1048576` decoded bytes, and standard RFC 4648 padded Base64 must decode, hash and re-encode exactly. Intent must be absent until exact registry/plan bootstrap has completed; API-commit must be absent until a validated `DISPATCH_ONCE` has durably committed; composite acknowledgement must be absent until both external components exact-verify; controller must be absent until that acknowledgement is durable. Each may thereafter appear only at its fixed path through its closed writer; state-dependent exact file-set goldens reject early/missing control, extra file, oversize/base64 alias or cross-attempt bytes.

Before activation, privileged Rust bootstrap-verifies the exact permanent 89-row registry envelope against the pinned corporate root under the ordinary current-verification rule, exact-matches its digest to both candidate identity and the release candidate, then create-new copies/fsyncs those exact bytes and the signed plan to the capsule. Once the dispatch intent value is frozen, privileged Rust first create-new writes/fsyncs/reloads those JCS bytes at the plan-fixed `dispatch-commit-intent.v1.json`, derives their only `ArtifactRefV1`, and create-new writes/adopts the same bytes in `EvidenceObjectStoreV1`; only after both copies exact-match may it append state row 2 and its journal event. It then copies only the framed GateRunJournal prefix through `CARRIER_CONTINUATION_PRE_SHUTDOWN_COMMITTED` and continuation-state prefix through sequence 2 to their capsule paths. Reload verifies registry size/digest/media, intent ref/media/digest and every intent scalar against both row 2 and the journal event, verifies plan/header/records with only capsule bytes, checks the total cap, and only then asks the control broker to set `ActiveRecordPath`. A crash after the fixed intent copy but before object/row/event completion follows that known locator to adopt the object and resume the same deterministic prefix without a directory or object-store scan; a permanent intent object without its prior fixed locator is impossible. Postboot ServiceMain repeats the corporate-root bootstrap and intent/prefix join before trust; it uses no ambient registry file, cached candidate, hardcoded signer or network. Full `ReleaseCandidateV1` verification is deferred until DATA_HDD mounts; a pre-mount failure is authorized only by capsule-authenticated plan/intent/prefix identity and can never PASS. A crash before a complete capsule leaves no activation; an unexpected reboot after activation still authenticates dispatch state without HDD. Capsule deletion is legal only after terminal/checkpoint durability and an offline graph walk has fsynced and typed-reloaded the permanent registry, intent, required API marker, required composite acknowledgement and both decoded inline raw objects. A golden deletes the entire capsule only after that proof and still recomputes PASS from retained bundle bytes; no capsule-only ref may remain.

`NO_AUTOMATIC_RESTART` excludes generic SCM crash recovery; the already installed control broker is the only same-attempt postboot supervisor. Because continuation depends on `EPAuthorityControl`, the broker does not report `RUNNING` on boot until it has read the one fixed activation value and bootstrap-verified its capsule. Before comparing boot IDs or creating a controller, it checks the fixed failure path: exact `DISPATCH_API_REJECTED|DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_DEADLINE_ELAPSED` require the row-2 `COMPARABLE_WINDOW`; exact `DISPATCH_OWNER_SESSION_LOST_BEFORE_API` requires the immutable intent and either its same-boot comparable window or a boot-change window; exact `DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_ABSENT_AFTER_BOOT_CHANGE` requires marker presence, composite-acknowledgement absence and `BOOT_CONTEXT_CHANGE`. These four pre-controller failures require controller absence, win permanently even after reboot and permit no continuation start; any other pre-controller failure conflicts. If activation exists, intent/prefixes authenticate, no pre-controller failure exists, and the fixed API-commit marker is absent, the broker must create-new/fsync `DISPATCH_OWNER_SESSION_LOST_BEFORE_API` before any controller initialization or `StartServiceW`: it uses `COMPARABLE_WINDOW` on the original boot and `BOOT_CONTEXT_CHANGE` after a boot transition. A later appearance of a marker conflicts; the owner token is never recreated. On the same pre-shutdown boot, marker presence permits only bounded composite reconciliation and no controller. On the first distinct postboot with the marker, the broker may only load and exact-verify a composite acknowledgement already fsynced on the pre-shutdown boot; it may query Event Log and UPS for diagnostics, but it must never synthesize a missing old-boot commit tick or promote those observations to PASS. If the fixed acknowledgement is absent, it durably writes `DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_ABSENT_AFTER_BOOT_CHANGE` with the observed incomplete pair before any controller/start; if it is present and exact, it create-new/fsyncs `postboot-resume-controller.v1.jcs.jsonl`. The header freezes boot/source/first tick, checked `deadline=first_tick+1800000` and `maximum_resume_generation=8`; an exact same-context header is adopted and generation nine selects bounded failure.

If later boot C sees a nonterminal B controller, it takes the controller lease and, before constructing `BOOT_CONTEXT_CHANGE` or any failure, strict-loads the plan-fixed success spool and authenticated controller prefix. A valid `SUCCESS_COMMAND_DURABLE` frame plus exact spool, or an exact fsynced spool whose embedded B-source accepted tick was strictly before B's deadline and whose digest/identity permits the one missing frame to be adopted, permanently wins: C never compares its clock with B's, never starts ServiceMain, appends/adopts the success frame using only the frozen B tick, projects/adopts the exact event/proof/restart triple, and appends `SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE_COMPLETED`. Only when neither a valid success frame nor an adoptable valid spool exists may capsule/controller plus the already durable composite acknowledgement authorize `POSTBOOT_CONTEXT_CHANGED` with `BOOT_CONTEXT_CHANGE`, followed by terminal `FAILURE_DURABLE` repeating B's last record tick. A partial/conflicting/late spool is tamper/UNKNOWN, not permission to choose failure. Plan/attempt mismatch or same-boot source change likewise remains tamper/UNKNOWN. Before each ordered readiness stage and `SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE`, ServiceMain sends `STAGE_ENTERED`; broker fsyncs before ACK. This no-output control lane is separate from the six postrestart/finalizer evidence-output discriminators and the pre-shutdown intent/API-marker/composite-control writes. Goldens cover marker-absent owner loss, both incomplete composite pairs, fixed-ack-before/after-reboot cuts, failure-before-controller-init, spool-before-frame, frame-before-each of three outputs, each partial triple, completion-before-cleanup and every B→C cut; they reject postboot acknowledgement synthesis, a late control after failure, controller/start after any pre-controller code, failure after a valid success spool/frame, or controller creation without marker plus composite acknowledgement.

The controller purpose wire is exactly `EP-F57-POWER-SHUTDOWN-POSTBOOT-RESUME-CONTROLLER-V1`; its internal media is `application/vnd.ep.f57-power-shutdown-postboot-resume-controller-v1+jsonl`. `docs/evidence/f57-release-evidence.schema.json` owns the header, record, record-kind/stage/code enums, `PowerShutdownSuccessPersistenceDraftV1` (purpose `EP-F57-POWER-SHUTDOWN-SUCCESS-PERSISTENCE-DRAFT-V1`, strict IPC-only JCS) and `PowerShutdownSuccessPersistenceCommandV1` (purpose `EP-F57-POWER-SHUTDOWN-SUCCESS-PERSISTENCE-COMMAND-V1`, internal media `application/vnd.ep.f57-power-shutdown-success-persistence-command-v1+json`). The draft is not a file: it is the closed caller-to-broker value and has no acceptance-tick field; the command is the broker-created spool that embeds that draft plus its broker-owned tick. Neither internal control file/value receives an ArtifactRef, envelope, signer row or offline artifact binding. Every controller record starts at sequence `1`, exact-hashes the complete preceding frame, and uses the header's same monotonic source; tick regression, gap, duplicate/conflicting frame or tick arithmetic overflow fails closed. The exact transition table is:

| Record kind | Exact legal transition |
|---|---|
| `INITIALIZED` | sequence `1` only; stage `DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT`; generation `0`; observed tick equals header `first_postboot_monotonic_tick_ms` |
| `STAGE_ENTERED` | same generation as predecessor; immediately after `INITIALIZED` it repeats `DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT`, immediately after `RESUME_AUTHORIZED` it repeats that record's stage, otherwise it is the next member of `DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT -> DATA_HDD_UNLOCK_AND_MOUNT -> JOURNAL_AND_STATE -> POSTGRES_RECOVERY -> DURABLE_CUTS -> UPS_RESTORED -> SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE`; tick is nondecreasing and no later than the deadline; a stage occurs at most once per generation |
| `RESUME_AUTHORIZED` | only after observed SCM `STOPPED` and the supervisor predicates below; same stage as predecessor; generation is checked `previous+1` in `1..=8`; tick is nondecreasing and strictly before deadline |
| `SUCCESS_COMMAND_DURABLE` | only after `STAGE_ENTERED(SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE)` or its same-stage resume; under the broker serialization lock it samples a same-source tick strictly before deadline, puts that tick into the command, create-new/fsyncs the fixed spool, then records its exact nonzero SHA-256; same stage/generation and tick; this record permanently wins the success branch |
| `SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE_COMPLETED` | only at stage `SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE`, same generation, after an exact `SUCCESS_COMMAND_DURABLE` spool and all three exact outputs; on the B controller's own clock it samples one nondecreasing tick that may cross the deadline because the branch was committed before it; after a B→C adoption it takes no C-clock sample and repeats the spool's frozen B accepted tick; terminal and mutually exclusive with failure |
| `FAILURE_DURABLE` | normally same current stage/generation after its exact mapped failure is durable and no success command/triple exists, with nondecreasing same-source tick; the sole controller context-change exception sets stage `POSTBOOT_CONTEXT`, keeps generation, repeats the preceding B-boot tick exactly and binds old/new clocks only inside `BOOT_CONTEXT_CHANGE`; terminal and mutually exclusive with success |

`success_persistence_command_sha256` is required/nonzero only on `SUCCESS_COMMAND_DURABLE` and is explicit `null` on every other record kind. A crash after spool fsync but before its controller frame may append only that exact frame after reloading the spool and proving its embedded accepted tick was before the deadline; this adoption is legal on B or any later boot and never resamples or compares a later clock. A frame without exact spool, spool digest/tick drift, or spool created after a serialized deadline decision quarantines the attempt. Under the same lock, absence of a valid spool at/after the still-comparable B deadline commits failure and permanently rejects a later command; presence of either the valid spool or durable success record requires output completion and forbids failure on every boot. `DISPATCH_API` is a preboot failure stage and is never legal in this postboot controller; `POSTBOOT_CONTEXT` is legal only on the terminal exception above and never as `STAGE_ENTERED|RESUME_AUTHORIZED`. No record may follow either terminal kind. Generated parser/transition goldens cover the INITIALIZED→first-stage boundary, every legal stage with/without resume, both sides of the accepted-tick/deadline boundary, every spool/record/three-output cut and every B-stage→C-boot cut; they reject skipped/backward/repeated stages, same-generation resume, generation `9`, wrong terminal stage, illicit cross-boot tick comparison, source/tick/digest drift and all kind/field cross-products.

While activation remains present, the broker subscribes to the continuation service's SCM status. A STOPPED/owner-death transition authorizes same-attempt `StartServiceW` only when the authenticated controller still names this boot/plan, no failure/cleanup or successful terminal suffix exists, no valid success spool exists, the success triple is incomplete, the same monotonic source has not reached its deadline, and the durable generation is below eight. It first appends/fsyncs `RESUME_AUTHORIZED` with `generation+1`, then starts the unchanged registered service; ServiceMain loads only that controller, adopts every exact existing prefix/object and resumes the recorded stage without redoing shutdown, UPS command, quiesce or an earlier completed readiness stage. If the fixed success-command spool exists, the broker completes/adopts its exact three outputs, appends/fsyncs `SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE_COMPLETED` under the same-boot or cross-boot tick rule above, and does not restart ServiceMain. At a still-comparable deadline or generation exhaustion, and only after proving no valid/adoptable success spool or frame exists, it create-new writes the exact failure selected by the durable current stage—including `SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE_FAILED` for that final stage—then appends/fsyncs `FAILURE_DURABLE` and never starts the service again. The broker has only `SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS|SERVICE_START` on the continuation SCM object, never `SERVICE_CHANGE_CONFIG|SERVICE_STOP|DELETE`; each authorized operator re-entry invokes this same supervisor audit and otherwise returns the same attempt as in-progress. Crash goldens kill ServiceMain before/after every stage-enter ACK, every readiness action, the failure send, every success-spool/output cut and each of the eight resume records; they prove either same-attempt forward progress or the one durable failure, with no stranded active plan and no second irreversible action.

The plan alone registers two location-independent logical refs: `power-continuation-relative://attempt/<lowercase-hyphenated-execution_attempt_id>/failure.v1.json` and the sibling `failure-cleanup.v1.json`, with their respective exact release media. During the live pre-mount phase the resolver maps them only to the verified capsule paths; after materialization/offline verification it maps them only to canonical `<staging>\continuation\...` paths derived from the signed plan. It never accepts a caller path, both physical copies as different logical artifacts, or a scan. Failure and cleanup are first create-new/fsynced at the two capsule paths using those logical refs. When the DATA_HDD is available, the privileged finalizer create-new materializes those exact bytes to the canonical paths, byte-compares both copies, and only then follows the signed failure sequence; it never re-signs or reconstructs them. `PowerShutdownContinuationFailureCleanupReadbackV1.failure_readback_ref` and the two FAILED-event refs use these logical URIs, so their bytes remain identical across materialization. The capsule root is deleted only after canonical terminal durability, but its content is classified non-business control evidence and protected by the certified runtime BitLocker state even if SSD remanence persists. Registry/candidate-identity drift, stale certificate at either verification, missing/extra capsule file, plan-before-registry bootstrap, hardcoded signer fallback, alternate logical URI or capsule/canonical byte conflict fails closed.

`WindowsAuthorityManifestV1` is the one plain canonical build/install contract, not an opaque file and not an installation readback. It fixes `schema_version=1`, purpose `EP-F57-WINDOWS-AUTHORITY-MANIFEST-V1`, media `application/vnd.ep.f57-windows-authority-manifest-v1+json`, the exact authority binary ref, exact installed executable path, and exactly the following five static `PowerShutdownServiceInstallPlanRowV1` rows. It contains no numeric `service_sid`, applied SDDL digest or installed-file/SCM readback because those facts exist only after installation. Every account is the displayed Windows virtual service account and static SID type is `UNRESTRICTED`; dependencies/privileges sort by the canonical table and `exact_argv` remains source order. All five static rows name the same executable and `installed_binary_ref=authority_binary_ref`. `RESTART_ON_FAILURE_MAX_THREE` means reset period `86400` seconds, non-crash failures enabled, and exact failure actions `RESTART/5000ms, RESTART/15000ms, RESTART/60000ms, NONE`; it permits neither command execution nor host reboot. `NO_AUTOMATIC_RESTART` means an empty action vector and zero reset period. Preshutdown policy is a static install/readback field: only `CONTROL_BROKER` is `ENABLED{timeout_ms=600000}`; the other four are `DISABLED` and have no timeout scalar.

The build must generate WiX `ServiceInstall`, `ServiceControl`, file, registry, pipe/facade bootstrap and ACL-template authoring only from those five typed static rows. A deterministic MSI-table extractor then exact-projects the built MSI back to role/name/display/account/SID type/start/recovery, canonical quoted image path plus argv tokens, dependencies, privileges, activation/IPC/facade identities and installed binary component; it must byte-equal the manifest before the signed artifact set can be emitted. Installation typed-loads that same manifest rather than inventing a row. Each post-install `PowerShutdownInstalledServiceReadbackV1` attestation sets `install_plan_row_sha256=sha256(JCS(the unique same-role static row))`; its nested Authority/continuation/control/signing-facade type exact-projects every static field, then separately adds the resolved numeric `WindowsSidV1`, token/SCM/pipe DACL digests, installed-file/Authenticode attestation and role-specific dynamic runtime readback. `scm_dacl_canonical_sddl` is the deterministic project serialization of the installed service object's binary security descriptor—numeric SIDs, uppercase ACE/flag tokens and literal lowercase `0x` plus eight uppercase hexadecimal digits—and `scm_dacl_sha256=SHA256(its exact UTF-8 bytes without BOM)`. `installed_file_identity_sha256=sha256(JCS(installed_file_identity))`, where the embedded projection contains the handle-resolved canonical path, certified volume identity, `FILE_ID_128` serialized as exactly 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, file size, binary digest and exact Authenticode readback ref; the nested ref byte-equals `installed_binary_authenticode_ref`, and binary digest/ref exact-match the static row. The role-to-endpoint variant is closed: Authority owns its recovery endpoint, continuation carries the activation child-key path plus read-only recovery endpoint, control carries its pipe, and each signing row carries its own pipe plus its role-closed forwarding policy to G0 `F57EvidenceSignerV1`. Wrong-role row lookup, hash-only assertion without the embedded projection, SDDL text alias, path/file-ID alias, endpoint/facade mismatch or one-field mutation fails. Thus build-time manifest, extracted MSI, installed readback and later POWER plan are four stages of one contract, while no build stage pretends to know a post-install SID.

| Role | Service / display / account | Source entrypoint | Exact argv tokens | Start / recovery | Preshutdown | Exact dependencies | Exact privileges | Exact IPC or activation endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTHORITY_SERVER` | `EPAuthorityServer` / `Enterprise Platform Authority Server` / `NT SERVICE\EPAuthorityServer` | `crates/platform/authority-kernel/src/dispatch.rs#authority_server` | `["authority-server","--service-mode","windows-scm"]` | `AUTO_START` / `RESTART_ON_FAILURE_MAX_THREE` | `DISABLED` | `[CryptSvc,EPF57DataVolumeUnlockBroker,EPF57EvidenceSignerBroker,EventLog,RpcSs]` | `[SeChangeNotifyPrivilege]` | recovery/readiness `\\.\pipe\EnterprisePlatform\AuthorityRecoveryProofV1`; HTTPS/API opens only after ordinary recovery |
| `CONTINUATION` | `EPF57PowerShutdownContinuation` / `Enterprise Platform F57 Power Shutdown Continuation` / `NT SERVICE\EPF57PowerShutdownContinuation` | `crates/platform/authority-kernel/src/dispatch.rs#power_shutdown_continuation` | `["power-shutdown-continuation","--activation-source","scm-parameter"]` | `AUTO_START` / `NO_AUTOMATIC_RESTART` | `DISABLED` | `[CryptSvc,EPAuthorityControl,EPAuthorityServer,EventLog]` | `[SeChangeNotifyPrivilege]` | activation child key `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\EPF57PowerShutdownContinuation\Parameters\F57ActivationV1` containing value `ActiveRecordPath`; recovery read-only `\\.\pipe\EnterprisePlatform\AuthorityRecoveryProofV1` |
| `CONTROL_BROKER` | `EPAuthorityControl` / `Enterprise Platform Authority Control Broker` / `NT SERVICE\EPAuthorityControl` | `crates/platform/authority-kernel/src/dispatch.rs#authority_control` | `["power-shutdown-control-broker"]` | `AUTO_START` / `RESTART_ON_FAILURE_MAX_THREE` | `ENABLED{timeout_ms=600000}` | `[CryptSvc,EventLog,RpcSs]` | `[SeChangeNotifyPrivilege,SeShutdownPrivilege]` | `\\.\pipe\EnterprisePlatform\EPAuthorityControlV1`; disjoint `POWER\|PACKAGE` typed protocols |
| `RAW_EVIDENCE_SIGNER` | `EPF57PowerRawSigner` / `Enterprise Platform F57 Power Raw Evidence Signer Facade` / `NT SERVICE\EPF57PowerRawSigner` | `crates/platform/authority-kernel/src/dispatch.rs#power_raw_signer` | `["power-shutdown-signing-broker","--role","raw-evidence"]` | `AUTO_START` / `RESTART_ON_FAILURE_MAX_THREE` | `DISABLED` | `[CryptSvc,EPF57EvidenceSignerBroker,EventLog,RpcSs]` | `[SeChangeNotifyPrivilege]` | keyless facade `\\.\pipe\EnterprisePlatform\EPF57PowerRawSignerV1`; authenticated forward only to G0 `F57EvidenceSignerV1` raw operation |
| `GATE_RUN_JOURNAL_SIGNER` | `EPF57GateJournalSigner` / `Enterprise Platform F57 Gate Run Journal Signer Facade` / `NT SERVICE\EPF57GateJournalSigner` | `crates/platform/authority-kernel/src/dispatch.rs#gate_journal_signer` | `["power-shutdown-signing-broker","--role","gate-run-journal"]` | `AUTO_START` / `RESTART_ON_FAILURE_MAX_THREE` | `DISABLED` | `[CryptSvc,EPF57EvidenceSignerBroker,EventLog,RpcSs]` | `[SeChangeNotifyPrivilege]` | keyless facade `\\.\pipe\EnterprisePlatform\EPF57GateJournalSignerV1`; authenticated forward only to G0 `F57EvidenceSignerV1` journal operation |

These five rows are the permanent Authority infrastructure contract, not a complete or fixed product-process inventory. Every participant in the compiled CapabilityGraph has exactly one generated delivery row in runtime-owned `WindowsRuntimeDeploymentClosureV1`: `ACTIVE` with one carrier-specific artifact binding, or `DEFERRED_DISABLED` with a closed reason and mandatory absence probes. The carrier matrix is strict and one-to-one: `WINDOWS_SERVICE -> WINDOWS_SERVICE_PE/WINDOWS_SERVICE_RUNNING`, `JOB_OBJECT_WORKER -> JOB_OBJECT_WORKER_PE/JOB_OBJECT_WORKER_RUNNING`, `IN_PROCESS -> IN_PROCESS_HOST/IN_PROCESS_READY`, `WASM_SANDBOX -> WASM_COMPONENT/WASM_READY`, and `HYPER_V_CONTAINER -> HYPER_V_CONTAINER/HYPER_V_CONTAINER_READY`; no shared native variant or optional service row may blur service and worker semantics. Every subordinate in-process/WASM row names an active host participant, every Job Object/Hyper-V row names an active supervisor participant, those dependency edges are acyclic, and artifact/host/supervisor/policy identities repeat exactly in live readback. Job Worker readback additionally binds its supervisor, Job Object identity and policy, token SID, boot/PID/start-key/held image and authenticated readiness session. A deferred row instead requires `DEFERRED_ABSENT` with service/process/endpoint/package/resource-reservation counts all zero. First-release local AI is fixed as `DEFERRED_DISABLED{reason=LOCAL_AI_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFERRED}` with explicit `NullAiProviderV1` business behavior and no `ai-inferer` process, endpoint, model package or resource reservation. Product process count therefore remains deployment-variable under ADR-0019: fixed historical nine-process language, installer side lists, directory discovery and omission-as-disable are forbidden.

The normalized WiX/MSI projection is exact. Role maps to WiX service IDs `AUTHORITY_SERVER -> EPF57SvcAuthority`, `CONTINUATION -> EPF57SvcContinuation`, `CONTROL_BROKER -> EPF57SvcControl`, `RAW_EVIDENCE_SIGNER -> EPF57SvcRawSigner`, and `GATE_RUN_JOURNAL_SIGNER -> EPF57SvcJournalSigner`; all five `ServiceInstall.Component_` values equal `EPAuthorityBinaryComponent`, whose key-path `File` row is `EPAuthorityBinaryFile`, and the embedded byte-identical manifest is `EPAuthorityManifestFile`. `service_name|display_name|virtual_account_name` map to `ServiceInstall.Name|DisplayName|StartName`; `start_mode=AUTO_START` maps to `StartType=2`; the common own-process type and normal error control are fixed and no interactive/desktop flag is allowed. `installed_executable_path|installed_binary_ref` map to that component/file target and extracted file digest; `exact_argv` maps bijectively to `ServiceInstall.Arguments` using the frozen Windows argv quoting/parser with no shell; dependencies map to the normalized `ServiceInstall.Dependencies` multi-string; SID type, required privileges and the control broker's exact `SERVICE_CONFIG_PRESHUTDOWN_INFO(7),Argument=600000` map to corresponding install/reinstall `MsiServiceConfig` records; the other four roles have no preshutdown row; recovery maps to the exact `MsiServiceConfigFailureActions` reset/non-crash/action tuple above. The control broker's compiled `HandlerEx` advertises `SERVICE_ACCEPT_PRESHUTDOWN` while RUNNING; after `SERVICE_CONTROL_PRESHUTDOWN` it reports `SERVICE_STOP_PENDING`, advances checkpoint/wait hint on the same monotonic deadline, and reports STOPPED only after the composite dispatch acknowledgement is durable or its mapped failure is durable. The four disabled roles never advertise that flag. Each role has one `ServiceControl` projection `{start_on_install,stop_on_uninstall,delete_on_uninstall,wait=true}`. The continuation registry projection creates only its dedicated `Parameters\F57ActivationV1` child key and ACL template and explicitly has no `ActiveRecordPath` value; endpoint/facade identities and `source_entrypoint_path` are carried by the embedded manifest and exact-matched to the compiled entrypoint registry, while post-install SCM-config/accepted-control/pipe/service-object readback proves their applied numeric-SID form. Any extra ServiceInstall/ServiceControl/config/registry service row, custom-action-created service, alternate component/file, quoting ambiguity, missing uninstall event or manifest/MSI/source/preshutdown projection mismatch fails the build.

`apps/core-server/src/platform/windows_service/dispatcher.rs` is the only immutable launcher registry for the five argv vectors, and `crates/platform/authority-kernel/src/dispatch.rs` is the only role-entrypoint registry. The launcher maps each exact vector to one closed numeric role only after verifying the signed kernel pointer/head, held DLL and ABI table; it contains no Authority, POWER, package, signer or recovery business handler. `docs/evidence/f57-windows-authority-manifest.v1.schema.json` is the sole schema owner for the plain manifest, static row and endpoint family; release evidence imports it once and does not redefine it. Service role, display/account/static SID type, kernel source path, launcher binary ref/path, argv, dependency, privilege, start/recovery policy and endpoint/facade are all exact-match fields across manifest, extracted MSI and install evidence; numeric SID and applied readbacks are post-install-only. An omitted, inferred or phase-confused cell is invalid. Byte goldens cover all five rows, every WiX/MSI table projection, manifest/artifact-set media/ref drift, row digest drift and build-time insertion of a fake numeric SID.

`WindowsSidV1` is a private binary SID with one deterministic decimal `S-<revision>-<identifier-authority>-<subauthority...>` rendering: no leading zero, alias, account name or whitespace, and binary↔text round trip must be exact. Fields declared as a service SID additionally require the exact `S-1-5-80-<u32>-<u32>-<u32>-<u32>-<u32>` shape and `SERVICE_SID_TYPE_UNRESTRICTED`; the recovery local-account SID must instead exact-match the live `EPF57Recovery` account object. Installation readback resolves each displayed account and exact-compares token group, descriptor ACEs and nested row. Account/SID swap, wrong SID authority/shape, a SID resolved from another service/account, textual alias, extra ACE or stale preinstall SID fails the service-table and ACL goldens.

The raw and journal rows are keyless role-closed facades. They own only their authenticated named pipes and frozen forwarding policy and may submit only their allowed operation kind/discriminator to the already G0-owned `F57EvidenceSignerV1` broker/session. G0's evidence broker is the sole owner of all non-exportable evidence-signing keys and key ACLs; neither facade SID receives a key ACE or raw key handle, and no POWER-specific key container is provisioned.

The distinct privileged allowlist broker has exact service/account `EPAuthorityControl` / `NT SERVICE\EPAuthorityControl`; its numeric SID is the `WindowsSidV1` resolved from that account and exact-matched throughout the readback/ACL chain. Its token privileges are exactly `[SeChangeNotifyPrivilege,SeShutdownPrivilege]`; on the global SCM it has only `SC_MANAGER_CONNECT`, and on the already installed continuation service object it has exactly `{QUERY_STATUS,START}`—never `STOP`, `CREATE_SERVICE`, `DELETE` or `CHANGE_CONFIG`, which could terminate or alter the pinned service. The broker accepts only the signed plan over its fixed authenticated pipe, may set/delete only the separately ACLed activation parameter, perform the one shutdown handshake, supervise only the bounded same-attempt postboot resume, and create-new the exact service-produced control/readback/proof paths after validating their complete bytes; it cannot sign either evidence kind, alter service configuration or write any other staging path.

`token_and_scm_preflight_readback_sha256` is not a naked claim: it equals `sha256(JCS(token_and_scm_preflight_readback))`. That embedded projection repeats the resolved numeric control-service SID, exact token privileges, exact singleton global-SCM right string `SC_MANAGER_CONNECT`, continuation service name `EPF57PowerShutdownContinuation`, and exact typed continuation-object rights `[QUERY_STATUS,START]`; its vectors use the canonical sort table and byte-equal the surrounding dispatcher fields and installed service row. Rust constructs it only from a live process-token query plus handle-grant probes that prove every listed access succeeds and `STOP|CHANGE_CONFIG|DELETE` plus every other forbidden right fail. An empty/nonzero-only digest, account label in place of SID, extra administrator group/right, mismatched embedded projection or one-field mutation fails before STARTED.

Raw-evidence signing and GateRunJournal signing are two separately installed least-privilege, keyless facades: exact service/account names are `EPF57PowerRawSigner` / `NT SERVICE\EPF57PowerRawSigner` and `EPF57GateJournalSigner` / `NT SERVICE\EPF57GateJournalSigner`. Each numeric SID is resolved from its displayed account by the common `WindowsSidV1` rule. Each owns one fixed authenticated IPC endpoint and a compiled role-closed forwarding policy; after independently validating a frozen request it forwards only the approved digest/operation identity to G0's sole `F57EvidenceSignerV1` broker. The facade processes own no CNG container, certificate or key handle, and their SIDs have no key ACE. The signed plan freezes both facade identities, IPC ACL digests, upstream endpoint, allowed artifact kind/discriminator and forwarding-policy digest plus one control token/SCM preflight digest. Before STARTED, trusted Rust readback exact-matches all three broker/facade services and proves G0 broker-session identity, facade role separation and absence of facade key access. A missing shutdown right, broad administrator membership, extra SCM right, aliased principal, facade key grant, cross-role forwarding or direct key access fails before the attempt without adding a signer-registry row; the existing raw and journal registry rows remain fulfilled by the G0 broker-held credentials.

The continuation virtual account receives only read/execute on the installed binary, read on the capsule plan, authenticated prefixes, intent/API-marker/composite controls and controller state plus the activation parameter's named plan/inputs/state/journal after the HDD returns, write access solely to the authenticated control-broker pipe, and connect/query access to exact read-only endpoint `\\.\pipe\EnterprisePlatform\AuthorityRecoveryProofV1`. It receives no PostgreSQL credential/role and no data/WAL/attachment/audit/Outbox directory ACE. The normal authority service exposes that one endpoint only after its ordinary recovery completes; it returns a typed attempt/barrier-bound `PowerShutdownAuthorityRecoveryProofV1`, while the continuation cannot issue commands or query arbitrary business data. The continuation cannot append either journal, sign an envelope, access a CMS key, alter SCM/registry configuration, request shutdown, or write the executable/bundle/capsule directly. The control broker—not a directory ACL fiction—has exactly six create-new evidence-output cases: plan-derived EVENT, RESTART and DISARM artifact paths, capsule-derived FAILURE and FAILURE_CLEANUP paths, and the digest-derived `EvidenceObjectStoreV1` recovery-proof path. EVENT, RESTART, DISARM, FAILURE, FAILURE_CLEANUP and AUTHORITY_RECOVERY_PROOF are the six closed output discriminators; each path is derived only from the signed plan plus that discriminator, with no caller path or directory-general write branch.

Internal controls do not increase that six-case evidence API. Privileged pre-shutdown Rust runs inside `EPAuthorityServer` under the AS service SID; `cargo xtask carrier run` is only its mutually authenticated client and never receives direct SCM/file/key privilege. AS alone writes the fixed intent locator before its permanent object. The control broker alone may write the fixed API-marker locator plus its one digest-derived object, the fixed composite-acknowledgement locator plus its object and the two digest-derived decoded raw objects, the fixed controller frames, and the plan-fixed success-command spool. Every content-addressed target is computed from bytes already reloaded at its fixed locator; no general `EvidenceObjectStoreV1` traversal/write exists. The private `STAGE_ENTERED|RESUME_AUTHORIZED` frames and success spool are not evidence-output discriminators, signer rows or PASS objects. The success command is allowed only at the plan's one staging-relative path, is create-new/fsynced before any of its three embedded values is projected through EVENT/AUTHORITY_RECOVERY_PROOF/RESTART, and is deleted only with permitted terminal staging cleanup. An extra/repeated message, discriminator/path mismatch, object without prior fixed locator or byte conflict fails; ARM remains a pre-shutdown privileged-Rust output and is not another broker case.

`PowerShutdownContinuationSecurityDescriptorsV1.descriptors` is constructed only inside the attempt-specific POWER plan after every path and SID exists, never in the pre-freeze installed-service row, and contains the following exact eighteen rows in enum order. The readable aliases resolve once to canonical numeric SIDs before hashing: `SY=S-1-5-18`; `AS|CN|CB|RS|JS` are the live service SIDs for `EPAuthorityServer|EPF57PowerShutdownContinuation|EPAuthorityControl|EPF57PowerRawSigner|EPF57GateJournalSigner`; `RT` is the dedicated `EPF57Recovery` local-account SID; and `EB` is the G0 sealed `F57EvidenceSignerV1` broker-session live SID, identical for both key rows and exact-matched to its token. No alias or placeholder remains in `canonical_sddl`.

| # / object | Action | Exact descriptor template expression before placeholder resolution |
