Rows 7/8 are dynamic-run objects, so their owner/group is AS rather than a fictional precreated SYSTEM owner. The installed DATA_HDD evidence-root parent grants AS only the typed create/list/traverse rights needed here; after durable run allocation, AS alone uses final-handle `CREATE_NEW`, applies these exact descriptors while owner, fsyncs and reopens/readbacks both objects before the POWER plan may reference them. Installation cannot precreate or guess their paths, and no privileged helper, inherited owner rewrite or later repair is allowed.

The frozen masks are object-kind specific and literal: `0x000F01FF=SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS`, `0x00020005=READ_CONTROL|SERVICE_QUERY_CONFIG|SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS`, `0x00000014=SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS|SERVICE_START`, `0x00020035=READ_CONTROL|SERVICE_QUERY_CONFIG|SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS|SERVICE_START|SERVICE_STOP`, `0x001F01FF=FILE_ALL_ACCESS`, `0x001200A9=FILE_GENERIC_READ|FILE_GENERIC_EXECUTE`, file-object `0x00120089=FILE_GENERIC_READ`, pipe-client `0x00120183=FILE_READ_DATA|FILE_WRITE_DATA|FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES|FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES|READ_CONTROL|SYNCHRONIZE` with neither `FILE_CREATE_PIPE_INSTANCE` nor `WRITE_EA`, `0x0012008D=FILE_READ_DATA|FILE_APPEND_DATA|FILE_READ_EA|FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES|READ_CONTROL|SYNCHRONIZE`, `0x001201BF=directory read/write/execute without DELETE|DELETE_CHILD|WRITE_DAC|WRITE_OWNER`, `0x001200AB=directory list/add-file/read-EA/traverse/read-attributes/READ_CONTROL/SYNCHRONIZE without add-subdirectory/delete`, `0x001301BF=FILE_GENERIC_READ|FILE_GENERIC_WRITE|FILE_GENERIC_EXECUTE|DELETE without DELETE_CHILD|WRITE_DAC|WRITE_OWNER`, CNG-key `0x001F019B=CRYPTO_KEY_FULL_CONTROL`, CNG-key `0x00120089=CRYPTO_KEY_READ`, `0x000F003F=KEY_ALL_ACCESS`, `0x00000001=KEY_QUERY_VALUE`, and `0x00000003=KEY_QUERY_VALUE|KEY_SET_VALUE`. RT has only `SC_MANAGER_CONNECT` on the global SCM; it cannot create, lock or enumerate the manager. It may open only names in the freshly verified `RecoveryServiceLifecycleClosureV1`: `0x00020035` for STOP_THEN_START rows and only `0x00020005` for the unlock broker KEEP_RUNNING row. The fixed installers and every additional ACTIVE/WINDOWS_SERVICE participant generate those exact per-service ACEs and live readback; no wildcard, prefix or runtime-created grant exists. CB's row-2 mask cannot query configuration: it verifies only state/absence and starts the continuation, while AS independently performs the final `QueryServiceConfig` and security-descriptor readback. Recovery restart/quiesce uses RT's exact derived per-service set and never changes configuration.

The placeholder resolver runs before any SDDL parser, so custom tokens such as `AS` can never be misread as a Windows well-known alias. Canonicalization starts from the resulting binary security descriptor and the project's deterministic serializer renders numeric SIDs, literal lowercase `0x` plus eight uppercase hexadecimal digits, uppercase ACE/flag tokens, a protected non-null DACL, no inherited ACE on these eighteen root/objects, and principal order `SY,AS,CN,CB,RS,JS,RT,EB` with parent-applying ACE before inherit-only ACE for the same principal. It never hashes an OS-version-dependent alias rendering. The UTF-8/no-BOM bytes—not the template expression—feed `canonical_sddl_sha256`. There are no DENY ACEs because absence denies, and no `WD|AU|BU|BA|AN|NU|IU|SU|CREATOR_OWNER` ACE. Descendant files under rows 9/10 may carry only the exact inherited ACEs derived from those roots. NTFS cannot enforce a filename allowlist: the DACL limits directory capability, while the typed protocol, `CREATE_NEW`, final-handle validation and complete terminal enumeration enforce the exact five broker filenames and reject extras. The CB inherited file mask is append/read only and cannot overwrite or truncate; real-WS2022 tests write/flush every allowed fixture through that mask.

Every runtime pipe uses `FILE_FLAG_FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE`, `PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS`, `nMaxInstances=1` and the protocol's frozen byte/message mode. Clients request only concrete `0x00120183`, never `GENERIC_WRITE`; a WS2022 negative probe proves every non-owner client is denied `CreateNamedPipe` for both a second and a recreated server instance. Clients open with `SECURITY_SQOS_PRESENT|SECURITY_IDENTIFICATION`; server impersonation is permitted only long enough to query identity, must observe `TokenImpersonationLevel=SecurityIdentification`, and immediately calls `RevertToSelf`. Delegation/Impersonation levels fail. DACL checks are followed by client/server SID, PID, process-start-key, held-image and nonce/role mutual authentication. Each dispatcher/facade IPC digest exact-matches its pipe row; rows 16/17 are distinct local nonexportable broker authorization/mTLS keys required in both self-hosted and enterprise-signer modes, not necessarily the remote evidence-signing private keys. They authorize the role-bound local broker session; a remote enterprise signing key remains behind the pinned provider and never appears in this eighteen-row table. No facade SID receives a key right. The provider must report `NCRYPT_SECURITY_DESCR_SUPPORT_PROPERTY`; otherwise it cannot host rows 16/17 and the separate local authorization-key provider is mandatory. EB live probes require `NCryptOpenKey` and the role-bound private operation (`NCryptSignHash` or the fixed mTLS proof) to succeed, allow public-key/SPKI export, and require every private/plaintext export including `NCRYPT_PKCS8_PRIVATE_KEY_BLOB|BCRYPT_PRIVATE_KEY_BLOB`, `NCryptDeleteKey`, export-policy mutation, security-descriptor/owner/DACL mutation to fail. Raw and journal signing requests go only through their distinct keyless facades after independent payload validation. An RT SID replacement is an explicit admission-held reinstall that atomically updates all five Authority SCM DACLs plus the three backup/unlock service DACLs and task/folder/pipe/executable ACLs before use; silent account recreation/drift is forbidden. Any other recipe/variant, descriptor/action/path/argv/account/dependency/privilege/recovery, writable binary, DB/data access, direct/cross-role key grant, shell command, broad directory grant or caller-selected continuation field fails before STARTED.

For row 8 and the append-only child files created beneath rows 9/10, “append/fsync” has one Windows meaning: WindowsAppendOnlyDurabilityPolicyV1 fixes desired access 0x0012008D, share mode FILE_SHARE_READ, FILE_FLAG_WRITE_THROUGH=true, force-EOF before every single-frame WriteFile, an exclusive range lock, close then independent read-handle prefix/length/hash verification, and FlushFileBuffers allowed=false. It never requests GENERIC_WRITE and therefore cannot gain FILE_WRITE_DATA/FILE_CREATE_PIPE_INSTANCE by generic mapping. Immutable create-new objects whose creator descriptor separately grants FILE_WRITE_DATA may use FlushFileBuffers before handle close; that is a different primitive. A Windows Server 2022/P340 controlled-power-cut qualification ref proves the exact append primitive across every before/after WriteFile/close/reopen cut and the UPS/cache policy; recovery accepts either the prior complete frame or the new complete hash-linked frame, never a torn/favorable prefix. The words fsync/durable append elsewhere in the Windows POWER flow normatively select this policy for these append-only paths and do not imply a forbidden FlushFileBuffers call.

ARM's `service_configuration_readback_sha256` likewise equals `sha256(JCS(service_configuration_readback))`. The embedded projection contains the exact pre-freeze `PowerShutdownContinuationInstalledServiceV1`, exact dispatcher authority with its preflight projection, all eighteen attempt-specific object/action descriptors, and `activation_parameter_absent=true`; those three nested values byte-equal the ARM's `applied_service`, `applied_dispatcher_authority` and `applied_security_descriptors`. Handle-based SCM/file/registry/pipe/key readback must reproduce them after verify/create. The future activation value is deliberately absent at ARM and appears inside the already protected child key only after row 2 plus capsule durability. A pre-freeze installed row containing runtime descriptors, ARM digest without its projection, descriptor/action/path drift, repair of a permanent object, early activation or one-field mutation fails.

The authority-recovery pipe returns exact JCS bytes for `PowerShutdownAuthorityRecoveryProofV1`, purpose `EP-F57-POWER-SHUTDOWN-AUTHORITY-RECOVERY-PROOF-V1`, media `application/vnd.ep.f57-power-shutdown-authority-recovery-proof-v1+json`. The continuation has one successful broker operation, `SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE`, carrying exactly one strict `PowerShutdownSuccessPersistenceDraftV1` with embedded event, authority-recovery proof and restart values. The draft parser denies unknown fields, so a caller-supplied `broker_accepted_monotonic_tick_ms` or command wrapper is invalid; the broker exact-matches the three values' common run/attempt/continuation/host/barrier and all recovery-cut scalars, computes the proof ref, and requires `restart_readback.authority_recovery_proof_ref` to equal the embedded proof's exact media/size/digest. Under the controller/dispatch serialization lock it rejects an already committed failure, samples the controller's same monotonic source strictly before deadline, constructs `PowerShutdownSuccessPersistenceCommandV1{draft,broker_accepted_monotonic_tick_ms}` itself, create-new/fsyncs/reloads that complete command at `success_persistence_command_relative_path`, then appends/fsyncs `SUCCESS_COMMAND_DURABLE` with the same tick and `sha256(JCS(command))`. Only from `command.draft` in those branch-committing durable bytes does it project/create-new, in order, the plan-derived event object, the content-addressed proof at `objects/sha256/<proof-sha256>`, and the plan-derived restart object; after any process death the broker adopts the exact spool/controller/output prefix and finishes the same three values across the deadline without calling ServiceMain or rereading live facts. Every recovered PostgreSQL/attachment/audit/Outbox ref and LSN/count scalar byte-equals the proof, and the final signed raw authenticates the restart that reaches it. A partial/conflicting command, unknown draft field, caller-selected tick, draft/command identity drift, output without its spool/controller binding, conflicting proof object, bare restart, digest-only claim, direct database query by the continuation, or proof/restart drift fails. The plain typed proof, IPC draft and ephemeral command add no signer-registry row: release schema owns their shapes, the read-only normal Authority IPC supplies proof bytes, the control broker supplies persistence, raw evidence supplies the signed reachability root, and terminal staging cleanup may delete the unreferenced command only after offline PASS remains reproducible.

For each reachable nested output `ArtifactRefV1`, its `concrete_artifact_key` is the canonical media-contract key `(root type, discriminants, JSON pointer, vector item kind/index)` and its staging path is exactly `artifacts/<sha256(UTF-8 concrete_artifact_key)>.bin`; each recipe's ordered raw-envelope entries use `raw/<two-digit-ordinal>.v1.json`, with ordinals frozen by the raw cardinality order. Entries sort by key, are unique, and contain the one expected media/output class. Every table command includes exact flag `-StagingPlan <staging>\plan.v1.json`; each displayed `-EvidenceOut` is the corresponding planned raw ordinal path, not a second filename. The first five scripts create-new write only those raw paths and never write the completion. `POWER_SHUTDOWN` is the sole cross-reboot continuation and its PowerShell is prepare-only.

The continuation state file is a closed permanent sole-store wire, not an informal log or disposable staging member. `PowerShutdownContinuationStateStoreV1` derives its only run-relative path from the persisted journal header and the one POWER attempt as `continuation-state/<ascii-lowercase-carrier-TestID>/<lowercase-hyphenated-execution_attempt_id>/power-shutdown-state.v1.jcs.jsonl`; its canonical URI is the exact segment join `evidence-relative://bundle/<RUN_DIR_REL>/continuation-state/<ascii-lowercase-carrier-TestID>/<lowercase-hyphenated-execution_attempt_id>/power-shutdown-state.v1.jcs.jsonl`. It create-new writes below validated `RUN_DIR`; caller/staging path, alias, overwrite, reparse escape or attempt/TestID drift fails. It frames one header plus exactly four records as `<len8>\t<JCS>\n`, sequences `1..=4`, phases `ARMED,PRE_SHUTDOWN_COMMITTED,POST_RESTART_COMPLETED,DISARMED`, hash-chained from the header. Every state prefix authenticates exact bytes and the corresponding signed GateRunJournal event carries the strict extending prefix. Phase refs typed-load respectively ARM, `PowerShutdownDispatchCommitIntentV1` (which exact-reaches QUIESCE and its UPS trigger/cuts), the complete signed power raw, and DISARM. Row-2 journal event `dispatch_commit_intent_ref` must equal row 2's phase ref and every duplicated scalar must equal the intent; this is the deterministic bridge across the two append-only files. Append/flush/lease/torn-tail/no-overwrite rules equal the main journal; accepted prefixes are signed by GateRunJournal records, so the state is not a second signer. Store, intent and all four authenticated prefixes remain for the run-retention lifetime after staging cleanup.

`crates/platform/ups-contract` and `docs/evidence/f57-ups-contract.v1.schema.json` solely own the UPS manifest/status/runtime-loss-episode/command/ACK nominals, closed vocabularies and split `UpsStatusPortV1|UpsOutletControlPortV1`; `crates/adapter/ups-windows` is the only Windows implementation. Plain `UpsAdapterManifestV1` uses `EP-F57-UPS-ADAPTER-MANIFEST-V1` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-ups-adapter-manifest-v1+json` and is transitively authenticated through the signed authority artifact set, so it adds no signer row. Status uses `EP-F57-UPS-STATUS-READBACK-V1` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-ups-status-readback-v1+json`; the strict plain immutable episode uses `EP-F57-UPS-RUNTIME-LOSS-EPISODE-V1` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-ups-runtime-loss-episode-v1+json`; command uses `EP-F57-UPS-OUTLET-CYCLE-COMMAND-V1` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-ups-outlet-cycle-command-v1+json`; ACK uses `EP-F57-UPS-OUTLET-CYCLE-COMMAND-ACK-V1` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-ups-outlet-cycle-command-ack-v1+json`. The episode's trigger ref typed-loads the exact newest status for the same manifest/identity/config/runtime/process binding; sequence is positive, `first_stale_observed_at_unix_ms >= valid_until_unix_ms`, and checked monotonic arithmetic requires `recovery_deadline_monotonic_tick_ms=first_stale_monotonic_tick_ms+60000`. It is create-new/adopted by `(deployment_id,authority_epoch,episode_id)` before its ref enters the hold cause; no caller ID/time/ref or later sample may rewrite it. The adapter executes only inside existing `EPAuthorityControl` from the held candidate kernel: manifest `implementation_binary_ref` byte-equals `WindowsAuthorityArtifactSetV1.authority_kernel_binary_ref`, and that object's reopened digest byte-equals runtime `held_implementation_binary_sha256`. Vendor DLL loading, alternate implementation ref, child process, shell and a new service are forbidden. Manifest/config/service SID/PID/start-key/held binary and live runtime-security readback exact-match.

`UpsAdapterVersionV1` has only a validated constructor and hand-written `Deserialize`; it accepts canonical Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 grammar without build metadata and exposes no `Default` or unchecked `From<String>`. `WindowsDeviceInterfaceClassGuidV1` likewise has only a validated constructor/hand-written `Deserialize` and accepts exactly lowercase hyphenated 36-byte GUID text without braces. The first frozen timing tuple is exactly `status_poll_interval_seconds=5`, `maximum_status_age_seconds=15`, `maximum_self_test_age_seconds=86400`, `maximum_command_ack_seconds=30`. `configuration_projection.configuration_generation` is positive and contains the only deployment selection; endpoint and credential remain solely in the manifest and cannot be overridden. `WINDOWS_STANDARD_POWER_STATUS` has an exact empty `supported_device_profiles`, combines only `WindowsSystemPowerStatus` plus credential `NONE`, declares exactly `{READ_AC_INPUT,READ_BATTERY_SUPPLY,READ_BATTERY_CHARGE,READ_REMAINING_RUNTIME}`, and has all three optional selection fields null. `SIGNED_VENDOR_ADAPTER` has a nonempty profile vector strictly sorted and duplicate-free by `device_profile_id`; every row has nonempty manufacturer/model, nonempty strictly sorted duplicate-free `firmware_revisions` and `controlled_outlet_group_ids`, the projection exact-selects one profile and one member outlet group with nonnull P340 power-path digest, and capabilities are the exact ten-value set.

Local-device transport pairs only with `SERVICE_SID_DEVICE_ACL_ONLY`; its device-instance ID is 1..200 ASCII bytes, uppercase canonical Configuration-Manager form with no NUL, `device_instance_id_sha256=SHA256(UTF-8 canonical ID)`, and the ACL parser exact-matches GUID/vendor/product/instance. HTTPS mutual TLS pairs only with `CNG_NON_EXPORTABLE_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE`; SNMPv3 authPriv pairs only with `DPAPI_NG_SERVICE_SID_SEALED_SECRET`. Network transport uses `UpsCanonicalIpAddressV1` numeric octets—never text, DNS name, IPv4-mapped alias or alternate IPv6 spelling—and `NonZeroU16` port inside one `UpsNetworkDestinationV1`; DNS/proxy/redirect booleans are all false. Runtime destination rows are strictly sorted/unique; standard/local vectors are empty and network is exactly the one manifest destination including peer identity. Any other carrier/profile/transport/credential/capability/destination combination is invalid.

The common status wire remains honest across both carriers. In every identity/status/command/ACK, `configuration_generation=manifest.configuration_projection.configuration_generation` and `adapter_configuration_sha256=SHA256(JCS(manifest.configuration_projection))`; no arbitrary digest, ambient configuration file or later override exists. Standard status has `device_profile_id=null` and logical `ups_adapter_identity=sha256(JCS({carrier_kind,adapter_manifest_ref,adapter_configuration_sha256,configuration_generation}))`; this identifies only the Windows carrier/configuration and never claims a physical UPS identity. Vendor status has `device_profile_id=Some(manifest.configuration_projection.selected_device_profile_id)` and hardware `ups_adapter_identity=sha256(JCS({carrier_kind,adapter_manifest_ref,device_profile_id,manufacturer,model,serial_number,firmware_revision}))`; the signed vendor-only identity readback and host fingerprint repeat that digest, selected outlet group and protected power path, while outlet command and ACK repeat those fields directly. Vendor status has no outlet-group or protected-path field: it repeats the manifest ref, configuration digest/generation, selected profile and hardware identity, and thereby binds the selected outlet group and protected power path only transitively through the exact manifest plus `configuration_projection`. Every status has `runtime_security_binding_sha256=SHA256(JCS(UpsIdentityReadbackV1.runtime_security_readback))`. The identity's initial status and POWER previous/trigger statuses exact-match that digest; previous and trigger also share the same boot/PID/process-start binding. Within that verified `process_start_key`, `status_sequence` starts at 1 and strictly increases; a process restart requires a new signed identity/runtime binding before a new sequence 1, and cross-binding sequence comparison or ref substitution fails. `valid_until_unix_ms` checked-equals `observed_at_unix_ms + 15000`, collection is scheduled every 5 seconds, a known battery percentage is in `0..=100`, and `active_alerts` is enum-sorted and duplicate-free. Freshness is the half-open interval `trusted_now_unix_ms < valid_until_unix_ms`; equality is already stale, so a trusted consumer accepts only the newest status satisfying that strict inequality for the binding. The supervisor records the first stale observation on its trusted monotonic source and uses only that monotonic tick for the non-resetting recovery deadline.

Standard status has `self_test=UNKNOWN`. Vendor `PASSED|FAILED` carries a nonnull `provider_attestation_ref` with exact `application/octet-stream` media parsed only by UPS-owner field parser `EP_F57_UPS_SELF_TEST_ATTESTATION_V1`; authenticated bytes exact-bind adapter/profile/hardware identity, serial/firmware, provider test ID, result and completion time. For P340 qualification and POWER, only `PASSED` is eligible and checked `0 <= status.observed_at_unix_ms-completed_at_unix_ms <= 86400000`; future, stale, missing, generic or cross-device attestation fails. Operation 05 remains `READ_ONLY`: the system reads this fresh provider-authenticated result and blocks until an operator/vendor has actually run a self-test; it never fabricates a test or silently turns a read into an unjournaled side effect.

The adapter persists its private operation row and samples `adapter_call_started_monotonic_tick_ms` from the command's exact `pre_shutdown_boot_id|boot_monotonic_source_id` **before** the first provider call can occur; crash/adopt may load but never resample or reset that marker. A scheduled provider response must return a canonical nonempty 1..128 ASCII `provider_operation_id` matching `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}`; the adapter durably binds it to `(ups_adapter_identity,command_id,command_sha256)` before ACK creation, and every provider schedule response, exact-ID query and operation-log readback must repeat it byte-for-byte. Empty, normalized-alias, changed or cross-command provider IDs are `COMMAND_STATE_UNKNOWN`, never grounds to resend. A provider result is admissible only when the ACK repeats that boot/source and checked arithmetic proves `adapter_call_started_monotonic_tick_ms <= acknowledgement_observed_monotonic_tick_ms <= min(adapter_call_started_monotonic_tick_ms + 30000, command.dispatch_deadline_monotonic_tick_ms)`. Response loss may query/adopt the already scheduled operation only inside that same inner deadline and must return the byte-identical ACK; at the inner deadline, an absent or unqueryable result becomes `COMMAND_STATE_UNKNOWN` with no new send. `first_dispatch_started_at_unix_ms|accepted_at_unix_ms` are reporting-only UTC observations and never authorize, order or time out the command. The separate 600-second POWER deadline governs only the outer User32/composite/preshutdown reconciliation and cannot extend or revive the 30-second adapter window.

Runtime-security optionals are a closed matrix: standard has both refs absent and an empty destination vector; local-device has a present device-ACL ref, a present deny-all outbound-firewall ref and an empty destination vector; network has no device-ACL ref, a present exact-endpoint firewall ref and exactly one structured destination row byte-equal to the manifest destination. Both optional field artifacts use `application/octet-stream` and are parsed only by UPS-owner field parsers `EP_F57_UPS_DEVICE_ACL_READBACK_V1` and `EP_F57_UPS_FIREWALL_READBACK_V1`; they add no schema, signer or release POWER opaque-parser row. Every mode requires zero unexpected loaded modules, zero child processes and zero credential export/secret exposure.

`WINDOWS_STANDARD_POWER_STATUS` is monitoring-only: Windows `255|0xFFFFFFFF` and every unavailable signal remain typed `UNKNOWN`; communication, self-test and output are never fabricated, and outlet control returns `CAPABILITY_INSUFFICIENT`. Highest-tier P340/POWER therefore requires a candidate-bound `SIGNED_VENDOR_ADAPTER` with the exact read/status/idempotent-schedule/query/log capability set. USB mode has zero network and a device ACL only for SYSTEM plus the control-service SID. Network mode allows exactly one manifest `UpsNetworkDestinationV1` whose address is canonical IPv4/IPv6 numeric octets with nonzero port, protocol and pinned peer identity; textual IP/DNS aliases, proxy, redirect and every extra socket are forbidden. Credentials are nonexportable service-bound CNG or DATA_HDD DPAPI-NG service-SID-sealed material and have zero argv/environment/log/evidence exposure. Any manifest/config/firmware/model/transport/credential/power-path change invalidates prior evidence.

UPS communication loss has a runtime fail-safe independent of the deliberate POWER carrier. At the first observation satisfying `trusted_now_unix_ms >= valid_until_unix_ms`—including exact equality with the 15-second expiry—the authority records that observation's tick on the trusted monotonic source, creates or adopts one immutable `UpsRuntimeLossEpisodeV1`, then atomically creates or adopts the deployment-wide `ProductionAdmissionHoldV1{cause=UPS_RUNTIME_LINK_LOSS{runtime_loss_episode_ref}}`, rejects new requests and long-running jobs, and starts one non-resettable 60-second recovery window from that first stale monotonic tick. The hold may be withdrawn only by an admission CAS that observes two consecutive sequence-increasing fresh statuses from the same adapter identity, implementation/runtime binding and configuration generation/digest, with communication, self-test, output and runtime all PASS, and appends `REOPENED` for the same episode cause. A single good sample, adapter restart, wall-clock change or later stale sample does not reset the deadline. If that predicate is not complete by the deadline, the local control path drains or positively reconciles accepted leases, performs the bounded authority checkpoint/write barrier, stops PostgreSQL and requests Windows safe shutdown even when cached AC input still says online. Missing outlet control or an unqueryable provider ACK means only that external outlet action cannot be claimed; it never blocks local safe shutdown and never licenses a resend. The next boot remains admission-held until human acknowledgement plus fresh UPS, power-path, DATA_HDD and PostgreSQL readbacks pass, after which the same cause-specific admission CAS may append `REOPENED`. Crash and timing goldens cover expiry equality, one tick before/after, samples at every 60-second boundary, process restart, monotonic-source change, AC-with-link-loss, checkpoint failure, PostgreSQL stop timeout and Windows-call response loss; no path converts UNKNOWN into PASS.

UPS schema/unit/byte goldens reject an alternate implementation ref/digest, arbitrary configuration digest/generation or illegal standard/vendor selection projection; noncanonical/build-metadata adapter versions or GUID/device IDs; DNS/textual/IPv4-mapped/aliased IP, port zero, duplicate/extra destination; a standard manifest with any profile or a standard status with nonnull profile/non-UNKNOWN self-test; a vendor manifest with empty/unsorted/duplicate profiles, firmware or outlet groups; vendor profile/hardware/identity drift; missing/cross-process runtime binding, sequence rollback/reset without a new signed identity; any expiry other than `+15000ms`; percentage outside `0..=100`; unsorted/duplicate alerts; stale/future/missing/cross-device self-test attestation; empty/noncanonical/changed/cross-command provider operation ID; a missing/resampled/private start marker, boot/source drift, monotonic overflow, acknowledgement observation after the inner `30000ms` deadline, query/adopt after that deadline, UTC mutation changing a verdict, and any attempt to use the `600000ms` composite window as an adapter-timeout override.

After STARTED, privileged Rust applies the exact attempt-specific SCM/key/SDDL plan, writes ARM/state row 1/`CARRIER_CONTINUATION_ARMED` while activation is absent, runs the prepare-only script and typed-verifies quiesce plus the previous/trigger `UpsStatusReadbackV1` objects, and bootstrap-copies the signed plan/registry to their fixed capsule locators. On that pre-shutdown boot it samples boot/source/tick, checked-computes the `+600000` acknowledgement deadline, generates one unpredictable command ID and constructs the full strict `UpsOutletCycleCommandV1`; that command contains no endpoint, credential, executable path, argv or raw vendor payload. It then opens one authenticated live broker session. Only `EPAuthorityControl`, whose token has `SeShutdownPrivilege`, handles strict `PREPARE_DISPATCH`: under its per-attempt lock it generates one unpredictable owner token, keeps plaintext only in that session, and returns `PowerShutdownDispatchPreparationV1` containing its digest. Rust exact-matches the preparation and embeds the complete command in `PowerShutdownDispatchCommitIntentV1`, purpose/media `EP-F57-POWER-SHUTDOWN-DISPATCH-COMMIT-INTENT-V1` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-power-shutdown-dispatch-commit-intent-v1+json`; command/run/attempt/continuation, manifest/config generation, UPS identity, owner-token, boot/source/deadline, outlet group and protected path all byte-match the surrounding intent, identity readback and policy. Its WAL order is exact: create-new/fsync/reload the intent at the plan-fixed capsule locator; derive and create-new/adopt its `EvidenceObjectStoreV1` object; append/fsync state row 2 whose `phase_readback_ref` is exactly that intent ref; then separately append/fsync `CARRIER_CONTINUATION_PRE_SHUTDOWN_COMMITTED{dispatch_commit_intent_ref,...}` whose displayed scalars byte-equal the intent. These four durable steps are never claimed atomic; every prefix is recoverable from the fixed locator without scanning.

`PowerShutdownDispatchPreparationV1` and the affine `PowerShutdownDispatchOnceCommandV1` have private fields and no public literal, `Default`, `Deserialize`, `Clone`, test-fixture or alternate constructor in production. Their sole construction/consumption chain is `open_authenticated_session -> prepare_dispatch -> [caller durably persists the exact intent] -> load_persisted_intent -> freeze_once_command -> dispatch_once`; the last call consumes the command. Session, owner-token, intent, state-prefix or activation drift rejects the chain, and a second freeze or dispatch has no constructible value.

Recovery starts from the plan-fixed immutable intent copy. Capsule-intent-before-object creates/adopts its permanent object; intent-before-state creates/adopts row 2; row2-before-event reconstructs/signs the event; drift fails. With the original live session/token, Rust completes capsule prefixes, sets/readbacks activation and sends the once-command while holding leases. Under one broker lock the broker exact-matches command/intent/prefix/capsule/activation/token, consumes the token, then obtains exactly one trusted dispatch sample from the current boot context: unchanged `pre_shutdown_boot_id`, unchanged `boot_monotonic_source_id`, one `api_call_committed_monotonic_tick_ms`, and one UTC whole-millisecond `requested_at_unix_ms` sampled immediately before marker construction. It requires `intent.committed_monotonic_tick_ms <= api_call_committed_monotonic_tick_ms <= intent.dispatch_reconciliation_deadline_tick_ms`; `requested_at_unix_ms` has no second source, is never derived from Event Log/UPS data and is never resampled on recovery. It constructs `PowerShutdownDispatchApiCallCommittedV1` with that persisted time plus `api_function="InitiateSystemShutdownExW"`, `machine_name=null`, exact `shutdown_message="F57_RELEASE_POWER_SHUTDOWN;continuation_id=<lowercase-hyphenated-continuation_id>;execution_attempt_id=<lowercase-hyphenated-execution_attempt_id>"`, `timeout_seconds=0`, `force_apps_closed=true`, `reboot_after_shutdown=false`, and `shutdown_reason_code=0x80040001`. The generated message is exactly `137` ASCII UTF-8 bytes, contains no NUL, and maps one byte to one UTF-16 code unit; the Win32 buffer adds the only terminating NUL. The broker first create-new/fsyncs/reloads these JCS marker bytes at the fixed capsule locator, derives and ingests/fsyncs the same bytes into `EvidenceObjectStoreV1`, reloads both, and only then may invoke those exact six `InitiateSystemShutdownExW` arguments; a capsule-only cut deterministically completes object ingest without scanning, while an object without its prior fixed locator is impossible. Purpose/media are `EP-F57-POWER-SHUTDOWN-DISPATCH-API-CALL-COMMITTED-V1` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-power-shutdown-dispatch-api-call-committed-v1+json`. Marker presence means the call may have occurred and forever forbids another invocation. Zero writes API_REJECTED with marker ref; nonzero proves only asynchronous acceptance. Goldens mutate every API scalar, marker tick/source/requested time, UUID/message byte, UTF-16 projection and either copy/order cut; they reject a missing requested time, a recovered/resampled value and any value copied from the later 1074 record.

Marker absence plus lost session proves `DISPATCH_OWNER_SESSION_LOST_BEFORE_API`, because broker code cannot call before the fixed capsule marker and retained object both exist. Recovery completes intent→row2→event, performs no API call, writes that controller-absent failure with null marker and leaves activation removal to the exact cleanup path. On a later boot, activation plus absent marker is resolved to that same pre-controller failure before any ServiceMain start. Marker presence always chooses composite-acknowledgement/deadline/boot-change reconciliation; missing object ingest is completed from the fixed capsule bytes and conflicting copies quarantine. `DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_DEADLINE_ELAPSED` is never legal without the marker; marker absence always selects owner-session-loss. Crash goldens cover every cut before/after token consume, capsule marker, object ingest, API entry/return and response loss and prove absent→before-API failure versus present→reconcile without retry.

Dispatch acknowledgement is one indivisible verifier predicate, not “the API returned”: it is complete only when both (a) the exact attempt-tagged `User32/1074` exists and (b) the certified UPS returns strict `UpsOutletCycleCommandAckV1` for the embedded row-2 command. Only after (a) may the control broker call `begin_or_adopt` for “turn the certified outlet group off `300` seconds after acknowledgement and restore output when AC returns.” Before any provider call, the UPS adapter create-new/fsyncs its private durable operation row containing the command ID/digest and exact `pre_shutdown_boot_id|boot_monotonic_source_id|adapter_call_started_monotonic_tick_ms`; recovery may load but never rewrite that start. Durable uniqueness is `(ups_adapter_identity,command_id)`: the same canonical command SHA-256 must `query_exact`/adopt the byte-identical ACK; a changed digest is `COMMAND_ID_CONFLICT`; an unqueryable or ambiguous provider outcome is `COMMAND_STATE_UNKNOWN` and is never resent. The ACK contains no `NEW|ADOPTED` flag. Once both components exact-match, the broker constructs `PowerShutdownDispatchAcknowledgementV1`, purpose/media `EP-F57-POWER-SHUTDOWN-DISPATCH-ACKNOWLEDGEMENT-V1` / `application/vnd.ep.f57-power-shutdown-dispatch-acknowledgement-v1+json`, with the exact intent/marker refs, preboot source, nonzero 1074 record ID, one bounded inline User32 record and the typed ACK. ACK command/digest/run/attempt/continuation/manifest/config/identity/serial/firmware/outlet/path/operation/delay/restore fields byte-match the embedded command and certified inputs, state is exactly `SCHEDULED`, ACK boot/source byte-match the command, and checked arithmetic proves `adapter_call_started_monotonic_tick_ms <= acknowledgement_observed_monotonic_tick_ms <= min(adapter_call_started_monotonic_tick_ms+30000,command.dispatch_deadline_monotonic_tick_ms)`. Its UTC timestamps are reporting-only. The composite commit tick uses the command's same source and lies between marker tick and the outer command deadline. The broker create-new/fsyncs/reloads it at fixed capsule path `dispatch-acknowledgement.v1.json`; while DATA_HDD remains available it ingests the composite, decoded User32 object and exact typed ACK JCS into `EvidenceObjectStoreV1`, but a crash or lost HDD after the fixed copy may finish those ingests later without scanning. EVENT is a pure projection and byte-equals both derived refs and parsed values. After API acceptance, the installed `SERVICE_ACCEPT_PRESHUTDOWN` handler remains `SERVICE_STOP_PENDING` under its exact `600000` ms policy, adopts (a) from immutable Event Log, and may adopt (b) only through same-ID/same-digest `query_exact` before the adapter's inner 30-second deadline; after it, unknown is final and the remaining preshutdown time may only durably close the composite/failure. It advances its SCM checkpoint and reports STOPPED only after the fixed composite or same-boot deadline failure is durable. Process death never creates a second Windows call, command ID or UPS schedule.

If Rust, the broker or their session dies after row 2, the token is gone and every successor is forbidden to call the Windows API even when no event exists. On the same pre-shutdown boot a reconciler may compare only the exact same monotonic source: before the frozen deadline it can only query/wait and, after (a), finish/query the same UPS command. At or after the deadline, while Rust holds the journal lease and the broker holds its dispatch serialization lock, it performs one final exact Event Log plus UPS query. If either component is absent, it create-new writes `DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_DEADLINE_ELAPSED` with `timing=COMPARABLE_WINDOW`, the exact nonnull API-marker ref, and `dispatch_acknowledgement=INCOMPLETE{user32_1074_observed,ups_schedule_ack_observed}`; only `(false,false)` or `(true,false)` is legal because the UPS command cannot precede 1074. If both exist, the composite succeeds and their bytes/identities are later projected exactly into EVENT. If the boot ID has changed, no successor compares the old tick or retries dispatch: ServiceMain uses the capsule to run the closed postboot composite reconciliation below. A same-boot source change, tick rollback, checked overflow or inability to make the final serialized lookup quarantines the attempt as non-PASS with activation retained until the next boot recovery path; it never authorizes a retry. Every ordinary failure uses the closed comparable timing variant and wall time is reporting-only; the later B→C exception uses only its dedicated noncomparable variant. Goldens cover both missing-component states, forward/backward wall jumps, source drift, tick rollback, Rust/broker/session owner death before/after row 2, before/after activation, before/during/after the API, before/during/after 1074 and UPS acknowledgement, either component arriving at the deadline-lock boundary, preshutdown-handler stop/crash/timeout, boot change before reconciliation and an unrelated reboot. This makes both irreversible actions at-most-once and leaves an ambiguous attempt safely failed rather than guessed. PowerShell, continuation account and every later re-entry are forbidden to request shutdown.

On the next boot, only that signed plan's ServiceMain may run, and only after the dependency-started control broker has durably adopted the pre-shutdown composite acknowledgement and initialized the matching resume-controller header. ServiceMain verifies the capsule plan, both authenticated prefix copies, API marker, composite acknowledgement and controller header; requires the controller's distinct nonempty postboot boot ID/source/deadline; obtains the current durable generation/stage; and treats `DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT` as a read-only verification/ingest stage. It never sends or resubmits the UPS command. If the fixed acknowledgement is absent or either inline component is malformed, the broker must already have selected the controller-free acknowledgement failure or tamper/UNKNOWN and therefore cannot start ServiceMain. `dispatch_acknowledgement=COMPLETE` plus its exact nonnull ref is mandatory for every controller-based failure and every later success stage. After HDD mount, the service create-new/adopts the acknowledgement object and its two decoded raw objects in `EvidenceObjectStoreV1`, then exact-verifies candidate/attempt/plan, original GateRunJournal/state prefix 2, immutable quiesce bytes and the complete tagged lifecycle. During readiness it produces no success evidence object. After the normal Authority recovery endpoint and all ordered stages pass, it enters `SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE`, receives exact proof bytes, constructs the exact restart value, constructs the single typed `PowerShutdownSuccessPersistenceDraftV1`, and sends only that draft to the broker. The broker alone wraps it with the accepted tick as `PowerShutdownSuccessPersistenceCommandV1`; spool durability makes the three-output projection independent of both processes. Once all three outputs exact-match, it appends `SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE_COMPLETED` to the controller and forbids another service start. ServiceMain then reports `STOPPED`, closes its SCM handle and exits. It never appends either journal, signs the raw, changes/disables/deletes itself, queries PostgreSQL directly, sends a new UPS command ID or requests shutdown.

After Windows login, the authorized release operator runs the byte-identical `cargo xtask f57 carrier run --recipe POWER_SHUTDOWN ...` command a second time. Because STARTED plus continuation prefix 2 already exist, it cannot launch PowerShell or dispatch shutdown; it first invokes the same supervisor audit and returns the same attempt as in-progress if neither controller success nor durable failure exists. On success it enters only the AS-identity privileged finalizer/reconciler, acquires the journal lease, typed-verifies controller `SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE_COMPLETED`, event, proof, restart and STOPPED state, and captures trusted `raw.context.finished_at_unix_ms` immediately before the first raw construction; it requires `restart.completed_at_unix_ms <= raw.context.finished_at_unix_ms < raw.context.expires_at_unix_ms`. The raw-evidence facade/G0 broker validates the frozen payload and returns only the byte-identical signed `PowerShutdownEvidenceV1` envelope; it receives no path or file handle. AS create-new writes/fsyncs/reloads those returned bytes at fixed `raw/00.v1.json`. Trusted CMS time must remain inside `[raw.finish,min(raw.finish+300000,raw.expiry)]`. There is no five-minute operator-login SLA because the signing window begins at this finalizer sample, not at restart completion. If exact raw bytes already exist after response loss, re-entry adopts them and their frozen finish time; if no raw exists, it may take a new sample, but it never replaces/re-signs stored bytes. Only after raw durability does the journal facade/G0 broker validate and return the exact next signed state/journal record bytes; AS's row-8 append adapter appends/fsyncs/reloads state row 3 and `CARRIER_CONTINUATION_POST_RESTART_COMPLETED`. It next asks the control broker to remove `ActiveRecordPath`, verify the permanently `AUTO_START` service remains registered/dormant/stopped, create the disarm readback with `raw.context.finished_at_unix_ms < disarm.verified_at_unix_ms`, obtains the exact signed row-4/event bytes from the journal broker and appends them through AS. Facades never write storage. Only after prefix 4 may common finalization create completion/result/terminal. A crash at any cut resumes only the next legal create-new/adopt step: existing exact spool/event/proof/restart/phase/raw bytes are adopted, shutdown/quiesce are never triggered again, and a running service, changed start mode/command line, missing permanent registration or remaining activation parameter cannot be declared disarmed. Missing boot transition/controller, alternate service/binary/path, raw before prefix 2, restart-after-raw time, proof/restart conflict, signing-window miss, cross-broker signing, wrong phase media, terminal before verified dormant state, ambiguous/missing attempt event or a second shutdown hard-fails.

ServiceMain has one closed boot-readiness state machine rather than a timing guess. If `ActiveRecordPath` is absent it performs only the dormant check and exits. If present, it reports SCM `START_PENDING`, increments the checkpoint every `5` seconds with `dwWaitHint=15000`, and uses only the resume-controller header's checked `1800`-second deadline. Its order is `DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT -> DATA_HDD_UNLOCK_AND_MOUNT -> JOURNAL_AND_STATE -> POSTGRES_RECOVERY -> DURABLE_CUTS -> UPS_RESTORED -> SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE`; before each stage it waits for that exact `STAGE_ENTERED` frame to fsync. The first stage uses only the runtime-SSD capsule to exact-verify the already durable composite acknowledgement. At `DATA_HDD_UNLOCK_AND_MOUNT`, continuation sends only the fixed operation ID and installed unlock-authority ref through the normal Authority pre-database boot endpoint; AS invokes/query-adopts only `EPF57DataVolumeUnlockBroker` through its typed pipe. The broker verifies the pre-HDD trust/authority/NV/policy/certificate closure, calls only `UnlockWithCertificateThumbprint`, and returns the plain authenticated `DataHddBitLockerUnlockReadbackV1`; no RT Scheduled Task or external-key byte path exists. Continuation, control, AS and RT never receive private-key or recovery-password material. Later readiness stages exact-match that readback, signed plan, certified HDD volume, original prefixes, authority barrier and UPS trigger; the final stage durably spools/projects the already verified three success values. Completion reports `STOPPED`. Locked/wrong HDD, registry/authority/NV/policy/certificate/broker drift, absent provider binding after SSD loss, auto-unlock, journal/state mismatch, PostgreSQL recovery failure, cut mismatch, UPS timeout or exhausted success persistence sends exactly one controller-based `PowerShutdownContinuationFailureReadbackV1` to the control broker at the capsule's fixed `failure.v1.json`, media `application/vnd.ep.f57-power-shutdown-continuation-failure-readback-v1+json`, then reports `STOPPED`; all carry `dispatch_acknowledgement=COMPLETE` and exact nonnull marker/acknowledgement refs. API rejection, owner loss, same-boot acknowledgement deadline and postboot composite absence are selected by the control broker before ServiceMain/controller and use their dedicated timing rules. `windows_error_code` is nonzero only for `DISPATCH_API_REJECTED` and zero for every other code. A process death is not itself guessed as failure: the supervisor resumes the exact stage until the durable deadline/generation bound, after which it writes that stage's one failure.

On the required operator re-entry, the privileged finalizer uses an exact four/seven partition. `DISPATCH_API_REJECTED|DISPATCH_OWNER_SESSION_LOST_BEFORE_API|DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_DEADLINE_ELAPSED|DISPATCH_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_ABSENT_AFTER_BOOT_CHANGE` require controller absence; API rejection and same-boot deadline use row-2 comparable timing, owner loss uses its intent timing rule, and absent-after-boot-change uses the preboot-to-observed `BOOT_CONTEXT_CHANGE`. Owner loss alone has null marker; the other three require the exact retained marker; all four have null composite-acknowledgement ref. The other seven codes require the already durable composite acknowledgement, an authenticated controller ending in `FAILURE_DURABLE`, and exact nonnull marker/acknowledgement refs; neither partition borrows proof. With DATA_HDD locked, the finalizer may remove activation, verify permanent AUTO_START/STOPPED dormancy and create fixed capsule cleanup, but it returns the same attempt as nonterminal/in-progress without appending FAILED/UNKNOWN or deleting the capsule. Once the certified HDD is available, it materializes byte-identical canonical copies and any pending retained control objects, then appends exact FAILED, matching UNKNOWN and checkpoint. An incomplete composite is an explicit external-hardware degraded branch: Windows may finish a clean shutdown without a proven UPS outlet cycle, so manual power-on and UPS repair may be required before this same operator re-entry; it is never advertised as automatic recovery and always ends UNKNOWN. It never fabricates success. Controller/capsule become disposable only after terminal/checkpoint and offline graph verification, while retained intent/marker/acknowledgement/failure graph still verifies. Goldens cover the 4/7 partition, locked-HDD disarm/re-entry, manual-power recovery after missing UPS acknowledgement, every marker/acknowledgement nullability/timing swap, failure-before-controller, mount/SCM/clock/owner/spool/output/copy cuts, eight resumes, B→C, tamper and mixed branches.

The failure mapping is the following exact total table; no caller or generic error mapper chooses a string.

The failure ref keeps its separately frozen failure-readback media. All six PASS readbacks and cleanup remain plain values authenticated by their reachable phase/raw/journal root; they do not gain independent expiry or signer rows. Release-schema/offline-manifest descriptor goldens reject a missing occurrence, single-character media mutation, generic JSON/octet-stream replacement, cross-readback substitution and any purpose/media mismatch.

`BOOT_CONTEXT_CHANGE` has exactly three constructor formulas and never samples or infers an old clock after reboot. For controller-free owner-session-loss, `previous_boot_id`, source and deadline come from the intent and `previous_last_monotonic_tick_ms=intent.committed_monotonic_tick_ms`. For controller-free acknowledgement-absent-after-boot-change, those first three fields also come from the intent while `previous_last_monotonic_tick_ms=marker.api_call_committed_monotonic_tick_ms`, after proving marker boot/source/intent equality. For controller-based postboot-context-changed, previous boot/source/deadline come from the B controller header and `previous_last_monotonic_tick_ms` equals its last durable record's observed tick. In all three, observed boot/source/first tick are one atomic C-context sample; a copied deadline, wall time, Event Log/UPS query time or later sample cannot substitute. Byte goldens freeze all three constructions and every cross-source/field swap.

The failure payload code/stage, FAILED error and following UNKNOWN error select one table row byte-for-byte. `COMPARABLE_WINDOW` is mandatory for eight ordinary rows: API rejection/acknowledgement deadline use row 2 and the six controller failures from DATA_HDD through SUCCESS_PERSISTENCE use the controller. Owner-session-loss uses intent-boot comparable timing or `BOOT_CONTEXT_CHANGE` after boot change and has no controller; acknowledgement-absent-after-boot-change uses `BOOT_CONTEXT_CHANGE` without a controller; postboot-context-changed uses that variant with a controller. Marker nullability is closed: owner-session-loss alone is null, while all ten other codes exact-load the same retained `PowerShutdownDispatchApiCallCommittedV1`; an acknowledgement-deadline without a marker is impossible and must select owner-session-loss instead. Composite acknowledgement is independently closed: API rejection and owner loss require `NOT_APPLICABLE` plus null ref; same-boot acknowledgement-deadline requires `INCOMPLETE` plus null ref and only `(false,false)|(true,false)`; acknowledgement-absent-after-boot-change permits `(false,false)|(true,false)|(true,true)` with null ref, where `(true,true)` proves only that both external facts are diagnostically visible after reboot—not that the missing preboot commit/tick may be synthesized; `(false,true)` is always impossible. All seven controller codes require `COMPLETE` plus the same exact retained `PowerShutdownDispatchAcknowledgementV1` ref. EVENT exact-loads the same nonnull marker and acknowledgement refs. Old/new clocks are never compared. Variant/code/controller/marker/acknowledgement mismatch, zero/alias, copied deadline or field drift fails. Goldens cover all eleven positives, the external-both-observed/preboot-ACK-missing crash cut, and every stage/code/ErrorCode/timing/marker/acknowledgement cross-product.

After the exact raw cardinality exists (and, for POWER, after exact authenticated state row 4 plus its `DISARMED` event), Rust typed-verifies all raw envelopes and nested bytes. For every non-POWER recipe it derives `completed_at_unix_ms=max(raw.context.finished_at_unix_ms)`; for POWER it exact-loads the row-4 `PowerShutdownContinuationDisarmReadbackV1` and derives `completed_at_unix_ms=max(max(raw.context.finished_at_unix_ms),disarm.verified_at_unix_ms)`. In both cases it derives `expires_at_unix_ms=min(checked(completed_at_unix_ms+F57_EVIDENCE_MAX_LIFETIME_MS),plan.expires_at_unix_ms,all raw context expiries)`, captures trusted `issued_at_unix_ms` only after signing one checkpoint over that exact raw/disarm prefix, and requires `completed_at_unix_ms<=issued_at_unix_ms<expires_at_unix_ms`. That durable event is the sole CMS issuance authority `[issued_at_unix_ms,expires_at_unix_ms]`; physical `completed_at_unix_ms` is never resampled and does not impose a five-minute recovery deadline. The producer signs/create-new writes fixed `<staging>\completion.v1.json` under exact media `application/vnd.ep.f57-carrier-staging-completion-v1+json`, reloads and ingests it, then appends/fsyncs `CARRIER_STAGING_COMPLETION_BOUND`. The completion's plan ref, the carrier result's plan/completion refs and every recovery adoption exact-select their respective staging-plan/completion media. For `BACKUP_RESTORE_CERTIFICATION`, runs 1 and 2 write only `raw\00` and `raw\01`; run 3 writes `raw\02`, after which Rust alone may start the complete three-entry finalization. A partial/early/raw-only POWER completion, digest/checkpoint/finalization drift, second start/bind, expiry extension/overflow, media alias or formula drift fails closed; crash goldens include recovery both before and after five minutes through the original expiry.

The dispatcher follows plan inputs/entries rather than scanning to discover evidence; after completion it may enumerate that one staging directory only to reject an extra path. POWER additionally cuts before/after the fixed intent locator, its permanent object, state row 2, journal event, every capsule prefix and activation write; before/after the fixed API marker, derived object and API entry/return; before/after User32/1074, UPS schedule acknowledgement, fixed composite acknowledgement, derived composite/raw-object ingest and OS termination; at next boot/controller/service/spool/output/failure/cleanup boundaries; and at materialization, FAILED/UNKNOWN, raw, disarm, completion, terminal and offline cleanup. Every success-eligible cut proves exactly one attempt-tagged User32 event, exactly one same-ID UPS schedule, at most one Windows API dispatch, same-attempt continuation without replay, and no terminal state before the registered service is verified dormant. Pre-controller cuts instead preserve their exact one/two-control failure graph, create no PASS/event claim, may require manual power-on/UPS repair, and end UNKNOWN without retry; controller failures preserve their exact three-control graph and likewise cannot fabricate PASS. An incomplete one/two-row restore recovery sequence becomes terminal UNKNOWN and is never continued; a complete three-row restore raw set may be finalized without rerunning a restore.

A release-carrier reconciler is the one deliberate typed-finalizer exception to the generic “existing TestResultStore result” adoption rule. After acquiring the journal lease for a stranded STARTED ID, it first appends/fsyncs that ID's one `TEST_UNKNOWN`; only then may it inspect the fixed plan-derived staging/result locators. If the same attempt's complete create-new raw staging set exact-matches the signed plan, it may start the one carrier-completion finalization when no start exists, or resume the exact started payload when it does; it then creates/adopts the completion, ingests already produced bytes, constructs and signs the first `ReleaseCarrierResultV1`, fsyncs it at the fixed TestResultStore path, and finally appends `TEST_RECONCILED`. Exactly the three ordered completion-finalization events `CARRIER_STAGING_COMPLETION_FINALIZATION_STARTED -> (CARRIER_STAGING_COMPLETION_BOUND|CARRIER_STAGING_COMPLETION_RECONCILED)` may occur between that UNKNOWN and RECONCILED, with BOUND and RECONCILED mutually exclusive; no completion-finalization or outer-result write may precede UNKNOWN on a recovery path. Crash/transition goldens cover every cut from STARTED through UNKNOWN, raw adoption, completion-finalization start, first signing, completion bind/reconcile, object ingest, outer write, RECONCILED and response loss, including recovery beyond five minutes, the POWER disarm/completion cut, 72-hour and three-restore rows; a start/bind/result before UNKNOWN and a second physical run are explicit failures.

The six signed raw envelopes above are exact `deny_unknown_fields` wires, not illustrative log shapes. The package lock is a closed reproducibility and anti-rollback value. `downgrade_allowed` is exactly `false` in V1 and has no policy override. `installed_files` is the complete package/SBOM-bijective vector of regular installed files beneath the engine root, strictly sorted and unique by bytewise UTF-8 `canonical_relative_path`; every path is NFC, uses `/`, is relative with no empty/`.`/`..` component, drive/UNC/device prefix, trailing dot/space, reserved Win32 name or case-fold collision.
